1: # BK7258 上移植 openvela 的正式实施指南
2: 
3: ## 1. 目标和结论
4: 
5: 本文给出在 BK7258 上运行 openvela 的正式移植方案。目标是保留现有 CPU0/CP 固件、bootloader、分区和低层芯片服务，将运行在全芯片 CPU1 上的 AP 固件替换为 openvela/NuttX，并完成可启动、可调度、可交互和可打包的内核适配。
6: 
7: 本文只采用一条正式实现路径，不把以下做法作为交付方案：
8: 
9: - 不修改 CP 固件来绕过 AP 启动等待。
10: - 不把 openvela 与 FreeRTOS/Armino AP 固件混链。
11: - 不使用只发送 ready 的临时 mailbox 驱动。
12: - 不通过构建后覆盖临时 `app1.bin` 的方式集成 AP 镜像。
13: - 不在 Secure/Non-secure 地址之间运行时自动选择。
14: - 不关闭 MPU、FPU 来回避架构问题。
15: - 不让 AP 自己初始化 PSRAM。
16: 
17: 正式结论如下：
18: 
19: | 全芯片核 | 正式角色 | 本方案处理方式 |
20: | --- | --- | --- |
21: | CPU0 | CP、系统控制核、原 FreeRTOS 固件 | 原样保留 |
22: | CPU1 | AP 主核，当前 AP 固件启动目标 | 运行 Secure openvela 单核实例 |
23: | CPU2 | AP secondary，原 AP SMP 的第二执行核 | 首版保持 reset，后续再启用 NuttX SMP |
24: 
25: AP 原 FreeRTOS 工程内部把 CPU1 称为 `core0`，把全芯片 CPU2 称为 AP 本地 `core1`。这只是 AP 镜像内部的编号，不能用于替代全芯片 CPU 编号。openvela 的调度器只运行一个逻辑 CPU，内部 CPU index 为 0；BK mailbox 和系统控制必须固定使用全芯片 `MAILBOX_CPU1` 及 CPU1 硬件资源。
26: 
27: ## 2. 资料和代码依据
28: 
29: ### 2.1 openvela 移植规范
30: 
31: 新平台应按 Architecture、Chip/SoC、Board 三层组织，芯片层负责启动、中断、串口、定时器、堆和芯片寄存器，板级层负责链接脚本、GPIO、控制台和板级初始化：
32: 
33: - `openvela/docs/zh-cn/chip_porting/porting_guide.md:13-29`
34: - `openvela/docs/zh-cn/chip_porting/porting_guide.md:83-114`
35: - `openvela/docs/zh-cn/chip_porting/porting_guide.md:452-539`
36: 
37: openvela 已提供 ARMv8-M 公共实现，不应重写 Cortex-M33 的上下文切换：
38: 
39: - `openvela/nuttx/arch/arm/src/armv8-m/Make.defs:21-45`
40: - `openvela/nuttx/arch/arm/src/arm_m/Make.defs:21-50`
41: - `openvela/nuttx/arch/arm/src/arm_m/arm_exception.S`
42: - `openvela/nuttx/arch/arm/src/armv8-m/arm_initialstate.c`
43: - `openvela/nuttx/arch/arm/src/armv8-m/arm_doirq.c`
44: 
45: 完整 Cortex-M33 参考平台使用 STM32L5，最小 ARMv8-M/NSH 配置参考 MPS2 AN521：
46: 
47: - `openvela/nuttx/arch/arm/src/stm32l5/`
48: - `openvela/nuttx/boards/arm/mps/mps2-an521/configs/nsh/defconfig`
49: 
50: ### 2.2 BK7258 芯片和三核架构
51: 
52: BK7258 是三核 Cortex-M33 AMP 系统，三个核独立编译、共享一套 SDK：
53: 
54: - `bk_idk/docs/bk7258/zh_CN/get-started/bk7258.rst:11-15`
55: - `bk_idk/docs/bk7258/zh_CN/get-started/index.rst:104-119`
56: 
57: 三个核的资源和角色：
58: 
59: - CPU0 是主核，负责系统控制和主日志输出。
60: - CPU1 通过 mailbox 与 CPU0 通信，主要承载多媒体/AP业务。
61: - CPU2 默认承载 USB 等独立业务。
62: - CPU0 最高频率为 240 MHz，CPU1/CPU2 最高频率为 480 MHz。
63: - 每个核拥有独立 16 KB ITCM 和 16 KB DTCM，共享 640 KB SRAM。
64:

71: ### 2.3 AVDK AP/CP 代码事实
72: 
73: CP 启动 AP 的代码路径：
74: 
75: ```text
76: CP main()
77:   -> bk_init()
78:   -> bk_pm_module_vote_boot_cp1_ctrl(..., ON)
79:   -> pm_module_bootup_cpu1()
80:   -> start_cpu1_core()
81:   -> reset_cpu1_core()
82:   -> CPU1 从 AP image 启动
83: ```
84: 
85: 证据：

87: - `bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/cp/cp_main.c:12-24`
88: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:323-374`
89: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_startup/system_main.c:141-202`

91: CPU1 启动地址由 AP 分区物理地址换算得到：
92: 
93: ```c
94: logical_offset = physical_partition_offset / 34 * 32;
95: boot_address = SOC_FLASH_DATA_BASE + logical_offset;
96: ```
97: 
98: `34` 是 Flash 中 32 字节数据加 2 字节 CRC 的物理占用，代码见：
99: 
100: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_startup/system_main.c:160-170`
101: - `bk_idk/components/bk_startup/system_main.c:141-174`
102: 
103: CP 设置 CPU1 power、boot address 和 software reset：
104: 
105: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_startup/system_main.c:173-195`
106: - `bk_idk/middleware/soc/bk7258/soc/sys_reg.h:117-141`
107: - `bk_idk/middleware/soc/bk7258/hal/sys_hal.c:297-316`
108: 
109: 原 AP 使用 `Reset_Handler_Cpu0` 作为 AP 镜像入口，但 AP 内部第二核实际通过 `reset_cpu2_core()`启动并进入 `Reset_Handler_Cpu1`：
110: 
111: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/bk7258_ap_bsp.ld:86-90`
112: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/cmsis/CMSIS_5/Device/Beken/bk7236xx/Source/smp/startup_cpu1.c:259-318`
113: 
114: 因此，本方案将 openvela 固件作为全芯片 CPU1 镜像处理，CPU2 不在首版启动。

116: ## 3. 固定地址和安全模型
117: 
118: ### 3.1 Secure 地址模型
119: 
120: 当前 AVDK 和 IDK 的 CPU1 配置均启用 `CONFIG_SPE=1`：
121: 
122: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/bk7258_ap.defconfig:41-43`
123: - `bk_idk/middleware/soc/bk7258_cp1/bk7258_cp1.defconfig:29-31`
124: 
125: BK 地址定义使用 Secure alias：
126: 
127: - Secure Flash：`0x02000000`
128: - Secure SRAM：`0x28000000`
129: - Secure PSRAM：`0x60000000`
130: - Secure mailbox：`0x41000000` 和 `0x41020000`
131: 
132: Non-secure 视图整体增加 `0x10000000`，但本方案不使用 Non-secure 视图。openvela 固定配置为 Secure 执行环境，所有镜像、向量、外设和共享内存地址都使用 Secure alias。
133: 
134: openvela 配置含义：
135: 
136: ```text
137: CONFIG_ARCH_TRUSTZONE_DISABLED is not required
138: CONFIG_ARCH_TRUSTZONE_SECURE=y
139: CONFIG_ARMV8M_CMSE=y
140: ```
141: 
142: 这里的“Secure”表示 CPU1 作为 Secure application 运行，并沿用 CP/bootloader 已建立的安全配置，不在 openvela 中重新划分 SAU、IDAU、PPC 或 MPC。BK7258 安全访问路径和限制见：
143: 
144: - `bk_idk/docs/bk7258/zh_CN/developer-guide/security/bk_security_overview.rst:16-60`
145: - `bk_idk/docs/bk7258/zh_CN/developer-guide/security/bk_security_overview.rst:64-149`
146: 
147: 安全启动链中 BL1 验证 BL2，BL2 验证 TF-M 和 CPU0 app 的资料见：
148: 
149: - `bk_idk/docs/bk7258/zh_CN/developer-guide/security/bk_security_boot.rst:12-85`
150: 
151: 由于当前 CP/AP 使用的是 AVDK 的三核镜像链，而安全启动文档重点描述 CPU0 app，正式量产安全签名时必须由 bootloader 提供方确认 CPU1 AP image 的签名对象和 manifest 归属。开发阶段必须使用与现有 CP/bootloader 匹配的安全配置，不能自行改成 Non-secure image。
152: 
153: ### 3.2 Flash 分区
154: 
155: `projects/app_ab` 当前分区如下：
156: 
157: 来源：`bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/auto_partitions.csv:1-16`
158: 
159: | 分区 | 物理起始 | 物理大小 | CRC解码后的虚拟起始 | 虚拟大小 |
160: | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
161: | `primary_bootloader` | `0x000000` | `0x011000` | bootloader管理 | bootloader管理 |
162: | `primary_cp_app` | `0x011000` | `0x154000` | `0x010000` | `0x140000` |
163: | `primary_ap_app` | `0x165000` | `0x121000` | `0x150000` | `0x110000` |
164: 
165: 当前 Secure AP XIP 地址为：
166: 
167: ```text
168: SOC_FLASH_DATA_BASE + CONFIG_AP_VIRTUAL_PARTITION_OFFSET
169: = 0x02000000 + 0x00150000
170: = 0x02150000
171: ```
172: 
173: 最终链接脚本不得直接写死这些数字，应包含构建生成的：
174: 
175: - `partitions_gen.h`
176: - `ram_regions.h`
177: - `sdkconfig.h`
178: 
179: 并通过预处理得到最终 `bk7258_openvela_ap.ld`。
180: 
181: ### 3.3 SRAM 分区
182: 
183: 当前 `app_ab` SRAM布局来自 `bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv:2-10`：
184: 
185: | 区域 | 起始地址 | 大小 | 结束地址 | 所有者 |
186: | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- |
187: | `AP_SPINLOCK` | `0x28000000` | `0x10000` | `0x2800ffff` | CP/AP协议保留 |
188: | `AP_RAM` | `0x28010000` | `0x54000` | `0x28063fff` | CPU1 openvela |
189: | `CP_RAM` | `0x28064000` | `0x3b700` | `0x2809f6ff` | CPU0 CP |
190: | `PWR_MNG` | `0x2809f700` | `0x100` | `0x2809f7ff` | CP/AP固定ABI |
191: | `SWAP` | `0x2809f800` | `0x800` | `0x2809ffff` | 系统保留 |
192: 
193: openvela 的主 RAM 只能是：
194: 
195: ```text
196: RAM_START = 0x28010000
197: RAM_END   = 0x28064000
198: RAM_SIZE  = 0x54000
199: ```
200: 
201: 必须禁止：
202: 
203: - 清零 CP_RAM、PWR_MNG、SWAP。
204: - 把 `AP_SPINLOCK` 放入 heap。
205: - 把 mailbox共享 buffer放入 CP_RAM或PWR_MNG。
206: - 让链接器隐式生成 `.itcm`、`.dtcm`、`.psram` alloc section。
207: 
208: ### 3.4 PSRAM所有权
209: 
210: BK7258有8 MB或16 MB PSRAM，映射起点为 `0x60000000`。传统 IDK中硬件初始化归 CPU0；AVDK SMP中由 CP负责初始化和电源协同，AP通过 PWC mailbox获取状态：
211: 
212: - `bk_idk/docs/bk7258/zh_CN/developer-guide/memory_perf/index.rst:28-79`
213: - `bk_idk/docs/bk7258/zh_CN/developer-guide/memory_perf/index.rst:161-178`
214: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/psram/psram_driver.c:249-369`
215: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:346-382`
216: 
217: 正式规则：
218: 
219: 1. CPU1/openvela不调用PSRAM PHY初始化。
220: 2. CPU0/CP完成电压、时钟、ID检测和初始化。
221: 3. CPU0通过 `PM_CTRL_PSRAM_POWER_CMD`通知CPU1状态。
222: 4. CPU1收到power-on状态后确认可访问，再注册NuttX第二heap。
223: 5. power-off前停止新的PSRAM分配，清退所有对象，通过 `PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD`返回使用量为0。
224: 6. PSRAM初始配置为MPU normal non-cacheable；未经共享buffer一致性验证不得打开D-cache。
225: 
226: 首个可交付版本仍然只使用AP SRAM，但这不是临时规避，而是正式内存分层的第一层：内部 SRAM 是 kernel/控制面，PSRAM 是由 CP 管理、由 AP 后续注册的可选数据面。
227: 
228: ## 4. 正式启动时序
229: 
230: ### 4.1 CPU0/CP阶段
231: 
232: CP保持原代码，不改变 `projects/app_ab/cp/cp_main.c`：
233: 
234: 1. Bootloader/CP完成CPU0启动。
235: 2. CP初始化系统时钟、电源管理、UART0、CPU0侧mailbox和必要共享资源。
236: 3. CP按 `PM_BOOT_CP1_MODULE_NAME_APP`投票打开CPU1。
237: 4. CP清除CPU1 power-down。
238: 5. CP将AP逻辑起始地址写入CPU1 boot offset寄存器。写入值为 `boot_address >> 8`。
239: 6. CP选择CPU1 RXEVT路径，释放CPU1 software reset。
240: 7. CP在 AON RTC 时间窗内等待 `PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD`，当前等待上限为500 ms，失败最多重试3次。
241: 
242: 代码依据：
243: 
244: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:323-374`
245: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_startup/system_main.c:173-195`
246: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_startup/system_main.c:203-220`
247: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/include/driver/pwr_clk.h:26-43`
248: 
249: ### 4.2 CPU1/openvela阶段
250: 
251: CPU1 reset handler必须严格按以下顺序执行：
252: 
253: ```text
254: CPU1 boot vector
255:   1. 关闭异常和外部中断
256:   2. 使用 boot vector 提供的 MSP
257:   3. 设置 MSPLIM/栈边界
258:   4. 设置 CPU1 固定身份，不写 CPU0 身份
259:   5. 初始化 Secure CM33 基础状态
260:   6. 设置 CP10/CP11，建立 hard-float运行环境
261:   7. 初始化必要的 TCM/系统 fault 状态
262:   8. 复制 .data、.ramfunc 和 runtime vector
263:   9. 清零 AP 私有 .bss
264:  10. 初始化 MPU
265:  11. 设置 VTOR 到 RAM runtime vector
266:  12. DSB; ISB
267:  13. 初始化BK IRQ映射和NVIC
268:  14. 初始化MBOX0 v2物理层
269:  15. 清空CPU1 RX FIFO，注册mailbox IRQ63
270:  16. 初始化logical channel和MB_CHNL_PWC
271:  17. 准备NuttX IRQ、heap和SysTick所需的芯片层接口
272:  18. 开启全局中断
273:  19. 调用 nx_start()
274:  20. 由 board_late_initialize() 创建PM worker、注册PWC服务
275:  21. 发送一次 PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD(1, 0, 0)
276: ```
277: 
278: 这个顺序的依据是：
279: 
280: - C代码调用前必须先完成SP、C runtime和FPU状态。
281: - MPU必须在NuttX访问heap和外设前建立，但runtime vector复制必须在MPU限制生效前完成或放在允许区域。
282: - VTOR必须在NVIC开启前切换，避免中断进入错误向量。
283: - mailbox必须在发送ready前具备完整RX/ACK能力；PWC的复杂动作由进入NuttX后的PM worker执行，因为CP可能在ready后立即发送PWC命令。
284: - `nx_start()`会初始化NuttX的任务、IRQ、clock和硬件，并最终创建应用启动流程，见 `openvela/nuttx/sched/init/nx_start.c:658-826`。
285: 
286: ready的正式含义是：CPU1已经具备持续运行和响应CP PWC命令的能力，不表示NSH或所有应用已启动。ready发送必须在NuttX调度器、UART、PM worker和完整PWC服务具备后执行，禁止提前只发送一个裸消息。
287: 
288: ### 4.3 NuttX启动阶段
289: 
290: 进入 `nx_start()`后的调用顺序：
291: 
292: ```text
293: nx_start()
294:   -> tasklist_initialize()
295:   -> memory_initialize()
296:   -> hardware_initialize()
297:        -> irq_initialize()
298:        -> clock_initialize()
299:        -> up_initialize()
300:        -> drivers_initialize()
301:        -> board_early_initialize()
302:   -> nx_bringup()
303:        -> board_late_initialize()
304:        -> nsh_main()
305: ```
306: 
307: 对应实现位置：
308: 
309: - `openvela/nuttx/sched/init/nx_start.c:757-826`
310: - `openvela/nuttx/sched/init/nx_bringup.c:293-501`
311: 
312: BK特有的CPU1身份、MPU、vector和mailbox transport初始化属于芯片层早期启动服务；PM worker、PWC命令语义、UART正式设备注册和ready发送属于NuttX board bring-up。这样可以保证ready只在NuttX调度器可用后发送，同时仍处于CP的500 ms等待窗口内。
313: 
314: ## 5. 双向量镜像设计
315: 
316: ### 5.1 必须保留Flash boot vector
317: 
318: CPU1 boot address直接指向AP镜像起点，因此镜像offset 0必须是有效的 Cortex-M vector：
319: 
320: - word 0：AP RAM范围内的初始MSP。
321: - word 1：Secure Thumb reset handler地址。
322: 
323: 原BK镜像在offset `0x100`保留 `BK7236` legacy download magic：
324: 
325: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/cmsis/CMSIS_5/Device/Beken/bk7236xx/Source/smp/startup_cpu0.c:229-231`
326: 
327: 外部IRQ向量表中的该位置会被magic覆盖，因此不能把这份Flash表作为运行时完整向量。
328: 
329: ### 5.2 RAM runtime vector
330: 
331: 正式链接脚本定义两套内容：
332: 
333: ```text
334: .bk_boot_vectors
335:   VMA/LMA: Flash image offset 0
336:   内容: MSP、Reset、bootloader magic兼容布局
337: 
338: .vectors
339:   LMA: Flash
340:   VMA: AP SRAM固定区域
341:   内容: 完整NuttX ARMv8-M向量表
342: ```
343: 
344: Reset handler完成 `.vectors` 从 Flash LMA复制到 AP SRAM VMA，然后设置 `SCB->VTOR`并执行：
345: 
346: ```c
347: __DSB();
348: __ISB();
349: ```
350: 
351: 不能直接启用NuttX通用 `CONFIG_ARCH_RAMVECTORS`，因为其实现会从当前Flash vector逐项复制：
352: 
353: - `openvela/nuttx/arch/arm/src/arm_m/arm_ramvec_initialize.c:77-105`
354: 
355: 当前Flash vector含magic时，这会把magic复制成IRQ handler。正式配置关闭通用RAM vector复制，由BK7258芯片层自行完成一次独立的runtime vector安装。
356: 
357: NuttX公共 vector内容仍然来自：
358: 
359: - `openvela/nuttx/arch/arm/src/arm_m/arm_vectors.c:102-127`
360: 
361: 链接器必须对两套vector执行512字节对齐断言，原BK脚本已有相同要求：
362: 
363: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/bk7258_ap_bsp.ld:94-114`
364:

438: ### 6.2 Reset/C runtime
439: 
440: `bk7258_start.c`必须实现：
441: 
442: - `__start()`。

447: - CPU1 Secure基础状态和FPU状态。
448: - MPU初始化。
449: - 调用 `nx_start()`且不得返回。

451: 不能直接链接原FreeRTOS CMSIS startup，因为它会定义另一套 Reset、SVC、PendSV、SysTick和 `_start`：

457: ### 6.3 IRQ
458: 
459: BK7258 AP IRQ表来源：
460: 
461: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/icu_map.h:28-94`
462: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/bk7258_ap/interrupt.c:114-245`
463: 
464: 已确认的外部IRQ：
465: 
466: | 外设 | IRQ |
467: | --- | ---: |
468: | TIMER0 | 3 |
469: | UART0 | 4 |
470: | TIMER1 | 13 |
471: | UART1 | 15 |
472: | UART2 | 16 |
473: | MAILBOX统一ICU source | 63 |
474: 
475: openvela `bk7258_irq.c`实现：
476: 
477: - `up_irqinitialize()`：关闭所有外部IRQ、设置VTOR、配置默认priority、绑定SVC/HardFault/BusFault/UsageFault/MemFault/SecureFault、最后开启中断。
478: - `up_enable_irq()`：按NVIC ISER或系统异常寄存器开启。
479: - `up_disable_irq()`：按NVIC ICER或系统异常寄存器关闭。
480: - `up_prioritize_irq()`：按NVIC优先级寄存器设置。
481: - `arm_ack_irq()`：NVIC无需单独ack，外设ISR负责清设备pending。
482: 
483: mailbox使用ICU source 63，系统中断组为GROUP1。`IRQ_MAILBOX0=48`和`IRQ_MAILBOX1=49`是旧header中的物理注释，不能代替CPU1最终NVIC表；CPU1正式实现使用 `INT_SRC_MAILBOX -> IRQ63` 这条 AVDK AP dispatch路径，并在阶段0用J-Link和寄存器trace确认实际异常入口。

485: ### 6.4 Timer
486: 
487: 系统tick固定使用 Cortex-M SysTick：
488: 
489: - `CONFIG_TIMER=y`
490: - `CONFIG_ARMV8M_SYSTICK=y`
491: - `CONFIG_USEC_PER_TICK=1000`
492: - `CONFIG_SCHED_TICKLESS`关闭
493: 
494: NuttX timer ISR调用 `nxsched_process_timer()`，参考：
495: 
496: - `openvela/nuttx/arch/arm/src/stm32l5/stm32l5_timerisr.c:87-147`
497: 
498: CPU1频率由CP/PM服务控制。频率切换时，CPU1 PM worker必须在临界区内：
499: 
500: 1. 暂停SysTick。
501: 2. 根据新的CPU1时钟重算reload。
502: 3. 清除pending。
503: 4. 恢复SysTick。
504: 5. 更新NuttX时间换算参数。
505: 
506: 不把BK TIMER0同时用于系统tick，避免与CP和外设共享同一timer资源。

509: 
510: 正式console使用UART1：
511: 
512: - UART1 TX：GPIO0。
513: - UART1 RX：GPIO1。
514: - 115200 8N1。
515: - UART0继续归CPU0/CP使用。
516: 
517: 地址和GPIO映射见：
518: 
519: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/gpio_map.h:26-40`
520: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/gpio_map.h:169-179`
521: 
522: 当前 `app_ab` AP GPIO配置把GPIO0/1作为I2C1，见：
523: 
524: - `bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/ap/config/bk7258_ap/usr_gpio_cfg.h:22-25`
525: 
526: openvela board配置必须明确接管GPIO0/1为UART1，不能同时启用AP I2C1。CP GPIO配置不修改。
527: 
528: 芯片层实现：
529: 
530: - `bk7258_lowputc.c`：early polling TX，供`up_putc()`和fault早期日志使用。
531: - `bk7258_serial.c`：实现UART lower-half的setup/shutdown/attach/detach/receive/rxint/send/txint/txready/txempty。
532: - UART ISR清除UART状态，然后调用 `uart_recvchars()`和 `uart_xmitchars()`。
533: - `arm_earlyserialinit()`在`nx_start()`前建立UART寄存器。
534: - `arm_serialinit()`注册 `/dev/console`和 `/dev/ttyS1`。
535: 
536: UART控制台不能依赖CPU0 mailbox日志转发，因为openvela替换的是全芯片CPU1，且启动故障时CPU0转发服务可能还未可用。

538: ### 6.6 MPU、FPU和cache
539: 
540: 正式配置启用：
541: 
542: ```text
543: CONFIG_ARM_MPU=y
544: CONFIG_ARM_MPU_NREGIONS=16
545: CONFIG_ARM_MPU_RESET=y
546: CONFIG_ARCH_FPU=y
547: CONFIG_ARMV8M_CMSE=y
548: CONFIG_ARM_DSP is not set
549: ```
550: 
551: MPU region按原BK属性表建立：
552: 
553: | 区域 | 地址 | 属性 |
554: | --- | --- | --- |
555: | Flash | `0x02000000-0x02ffffff` | Secure RO/X，write-through |
556: | AP instruction alias | `0x08000000-0x0809ffff` | RO/X |
557: | DTCM | `0x20000000-0x20003fff` | RW/XN，non-cacheable |
558: | AP SRAM | `0x28010000-0x28063fff` | RW/XN，shareable |
559: | PWR_MNG | `0x2809f700-0x2809f7ff` | RW，Device，shareable |
560: | peripheral | `0x40000000-0x5fffffff` | Device，XN，shareable |
561: | PSRAM | `0x60000000-0x63ffffff` | RW/XN，non-cacheable |
562: | QSPI0 | `0x64000000-0x67ffffff` | non-cacheable，XN |
563: | QSPI1 | `0x68000000-0x6bffffff` | non-cacheable，XN |
564: 
565: 参考：`bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/mpu_cfg.c:38-149`。
566: 
567: FPU从reset阶段启用CP10/CP11，所有对象统一hard-float。NuttX公共层负责线程浮点上下文保存，不能把FPU支持延后到另一个ABI。
568: 
569: I-cache和D-cache在正式第一版保持关闭，因为现有 `mbox0_adapter.c`在发送端没有与接收端对称的D-cache clean/invalidate：
570: 
571: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.c:15-38`
572: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.c:99-128`
573: 
574: 后续若启用D-cache，必须先将mailbox共享buffer放到non-cacheable MPU region，或者为发送、接收和所有权交接实现完整32字节cache line clean/invalidate、DMB和DSB。

576: ## 7. Mailbox v2和PWC服务
577: 
578: ### 7.1 不能使用旧版裸mailbox
579: 
580: AP配置明确启用 `CONFIG_MAILBOX_V2_0`：
581: 
582: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/bk7258_ap.defconfig:28-30`
583: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/common/CMakeLists.txt:71-81`
584: 
585: mailbox v2的实际数据链为：
586: 
587: ```text
588: logical command
589:   -> mailbox_channel物理头
590:   -> AP共享SRAM buffer
591:   -> MBOX0 FIFO发送buffer pointer + length
592:   -> 对端从共享SRAM读取16字节message
593:   -> command/ACK状态机
594: ```
595: 
596: 证据：
597: 
598: - physical header含 `cmd/state/ctrl/tx_seq/logical_chnl`：`bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c:51-71`
599: - logical TX写入sequence和logical channel：`bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c:207-223`
600: - mailbox发送共享buffer指针和长度：`bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.c:99-128`
601: - MBOX0 FIFO长度和channel配置：`bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_drv.c:6-27`
602: - 当前AP CMake编译v2驱动：`bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/CMakeLists.txt:392-423`
603: 
604: ### 7.2 CPU1必须实现的transport
605: 
606: openvela芯片层必须完整移植以下逻辑，不能仅保留ready：
607: 
608: 1. `mbox0_ll.h`、`mbox0_struct.h`、`mbox0_hal.c`对应的寄存器和FIFO操作。
609: 2. CPU1 channel的FIFO起始地址、长度和owner配置。
610: 3. `INT_SRC_MAILBOX`到NVIC IRQ63的注册、使能、清pending和FIFO drain。
611: 4. RX FIFO中所有message的循环读取，不能每次中断只取一个。
612: 5. 发送共享buffer池，至少保留command和ACK的独立buffer，32字节对齐。
613: 6. physical message的pointer/length envelope。
614: 7. logical channel source/destination编码。
615: 8. `tx_seq`递增、reset和重新同步。
616: 9. `CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX`、`CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX`和`CHNL_CTRL_RESET`处理。
617: 10. command RX、ACK RX、发送完成和busy状态机。
618: 11. NuttX临界区/spinlock保护，禁止使用FreeRTOS临界区和semaphore。
619: 12. transport错误计数、超时、FIFO full、非法source/destination和reset恢复。
620: 
621: 应以这些文件为协议移植依据，而不是自行重新定义格式：
622: 
623: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_drv.c`
624: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.c`
625: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/common/hal/mbox0_hal.c`
626: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/hal/mbox0_ll.h`
627: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c`
628: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h`
629: 
630: CPU1的逻辑身份固定：
631: 
632: ```c
633: #define SELF_CPU MAILBOX_CPU1
634: ```
635: 
636: PWC是CPU1到CPU0的逻辑channel：
637: 
638: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h:47-100`
639: 
640: ### 7.3 PWC命令服务
641: 
642: PWC命令定义：
643: 
644: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/pwr_clk.h:26-43`
645: 
646: CPU1必须实现以下服务：
647: 
648: | 命令 | CPU1处理 |
649: | --- | --- |
650: | `PM_POWER_CTRL_CMD` | 更新CPU1模块电源状态并返回结果 |
651: | `PM_CLK_CTRL_CMD` | 更新时钟状态，必要时重装SysTick |
652: | `PM_SLEEP_CTRL_CMD` | 进入/退出指定睡眠状态，使用PM worker执行 |
653: | `PM_CPU_FREQ_CTRL_CMD` | 切换CPU1频率并返回结果 |
654: | `PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD` | CPU1只发送一次，`param1=1` |
655: | `PM_CTRL_EXTERNAL_LDO_CMD` | 执行或拒绝外部LDO请求并返回明确状态 |
656: | `PM_CTRL_PSRAM_POWER_CMD` | 更新PSRAM power状态，禁止ISR直接初始化PHY |
657: | `PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD` | 返回PSRAM使用量或释放确认 |
658: | `PM_CP1_DUMP_PSRAM_MALLOC_INFO_CMD` | 输出当前PSRAM分配状态 |
659: | `PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD` | 进入quiesce、停止服务、返回recovery状态 |
660: | `PM_RTC_DEEPSLEEP_CMD` | 记录RTC睡眠状态并通知PM worker |
661: | `PM_GET_PM_DATA_CMD` | 返回CPU1 PM状态 |
662: | `PM_CTRL_AP_STATE_CMD` | 更新AP运行状态 |
663: | `PM_ENTER_DEEP_SLEEP_CMD` | 通过PM worker进入深睡眠流程 |
664: | `PM_WAKEUP_CONFIG_CMD` | 更新唤醒源配置 |
665: | `PM_SLEEP_WAKEUP_NOTIFY_CMD` | 投递唤醒事件 |
666: 
667: 原AP PWC RX handler已给出命令处理边界：
668: 
669: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:288-439`
670: 
671: openvela实现必须保持同样的分层：
672: 
673: ```text
674: mailbox ISR
675:   -> 校验transport和命令
676:   -> 完成必要ACK
677:   -> 投递PWC消息到高优先级PM worker
678:   -> PM worker执行电源/时钟/PSRAM/recovery动作
679:   -> 发送语义响应
680: ```
681: 
682: ISR禁止执行PSRAM初始化、频率切换、文件系统操作、阻塞等待或复杂日志输出。
683: 
684: ### 7.4 Ready时序
685: 
686: ready必须在以下条件全部满足后发送：
687: 
688: - runtime vector已经安装。
689: - MPU已经生效。
690: - MBOX0物理层已经初始化。
691: - CPU1 RX FIFO已清空。
692: - IRQ63已经注册并使能。
693: - `MB_CHNL_PWC`已经open并注册RX/ACK回调。
694: - NuttX heap、IRQ和clock基础设施已经初始化。
695: - NuttX调度器已运行，PM worker已经创建并可以接收PWC消息。
696: 
697: ready发送内容固定为：
698: 
699: ```text
700: cmd    = PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD (0x5)
701: param1 = 1
702: param2 = 0
703: param3 = 0
704: ```
705: 
706: CP等待窗口当前为500 ms，连续3次失败后可触发重启：
707: 
708: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:341-371`
709: 
710: 目标是冷启动 ready P99 小于200 ms，为CP窗口保留足够裕量。
711: 
712: ## 8. 链接脚本
713: 
714: ### 8.1 MEMORY
715: 
716: 链接脚本从生成header取得值，当前有效值为：
717: 
718: ```ld
719: FLASH (rx) : ORIGIN = 0x02150000, LENGTH = 0x00110000
720: RAM   (rwx): ORIGIN = 0x28010000, LENGTH = 0x00054000
721: ```
722: 
723: 同时定义：
724: 
725: ```ld
726: __ap_ram_start = 0x28010000;
727: __ap_ram_end   = 0x28064000;
728: ```
729: 
730: ### 8.2 sections
731: 
732: 必须包含：
733: 
734: - `.bk_boot_vectors`：镜像offset 0，512字节对齐。
735: - `.gnu.sgstubs`：32字节对齐，Secure build使用。
736: - `.text`、`.rodata`、`.init_array`。
737: - `.ARM.extab`、`.ARM.exidx`。
738: - `.data > RAM AT > FLASH`及 `_sdata/_edata/_eronly`。
739: - `.bss > RAM`及 `_sbss/_ebss`。
740: - `.ram_vectors > RAM AT > FLASH`，512字节对齐。
741: - `.ramfunc > RAM AT > FLASH`，只允许明确标记的启动/底层代码。
742: - `__idle_stack_top`和中断栈。
743: - openvela heap结束于 `__ap_ram_end`。
744: 
745: ### 8.3 链接断言
746: 
747: 必须加入：
748: 
749: ```ld
750: ASSERT(ORIGIN(FLASH) == (SOC_FLASH_DATA_BASE + CONFIG_AP_VIRTUAL_PARTITION_OFFSET),
751:        "AP flash origin mismatch")
752: ASSERT(ORIGIN(RAM) == CONFIG_AP_RAM_ADDR, "AP RAM origin mismatch")
753: ASSERT((ADDR(.bk_boot_vectors) & 0x1ff) == 0, "boot vector alignment")
754: ASSERT((ADDR(.ram_vectors) & 0x1ff) == 0, "runtime vector alignment")
755: ASSERT(__bss_end__ <= __ap_ram_end, "AP bss overlaps CP RAM")
756: ASSERT(__heap_start < __ap_ram_end, "AP heap is empty or outside RAM")
757: ```
758: 
759: 构建脚本必须拒绝以下alloc section：
760: 
761: - `.psram.data`
762: - `.psram.bss`
763: - `.itcm`，除非有明确ITCM映射和复制表
764: - `.dtcm`，除非有明确DTCM映射和复制表
765: - CP共享区中未经批准的section

820: ## 10. Board初始化和服务启动
821: 
822: ### 10.1 board early
823: 
824: `board_early_initialize()`只执行不阻塞的板级动作：
825: 
826: - GPIO0/1切换为UART1。
827: - UART1 pinmux和低级配置。
828: - 必要的CPU1 GPIO状态。
829: - 不启动USB、Wi-Fi、媒体和CPU2。
830: 
831: 不得在此阶段等待semaphore、访问文件系统或启动复杂服务。openvela文档明确early hook位于核心组件完成前：
832: 
833: - `openvela/docs/zh-cn/device_dev_guide/kernel/boot_process.md:37-45`
834: 
835: ### 10.2 board late
836: 
837: `board_late_initialize()`执行：
838: 
839: - 注册UART1正式驱动。
840: - 启动PWC PM worker并在其可运行后发送CPU1 ready。
841: - 启动mailbox诊断和错误统计线程。
842: - 发送CPU1 ready前确认transport状态。
843: - 初始化NuttX基础设备。
844: 
845: ### 10.3 board app initialize
846: 
847: `board_app_initialize()`执行：
848: 
849: - `/dev/console`验证。
850: - procfs、ROMFS和NSH依赖初始化。
851: - 后续注册PSRAM heap，但必须先收到CP的PSRAM ready通知。
852: 
853: 不在首版启动任何要求CPU2、Wi-Fi、BT、媒体或AP SMP的服务。

855: ## 11. 构建和正式打包
856: 
857: ### 11.1 两个独立工程
858: 
859: openvela AP和BK CP保持独立构建：
860: 
861: ```text
862: openvela
863:   -> BK7258 CPU1 Secure ELF/map/raw binary
864: 
865: bk_avdk_smp
866:   -> bootloader
867:   -> CPU0 CP app.bin
868:   -> partitions_gen.h / ram_regions.h / bk_package.json
869:   -> all-app.bin
870: ```
871: 
872: 不把openvela源文件加入 `bk_avdk_smp/ap` 的CMake。这样可以避免两套startup、libc wrapper、heap、SVC、PendSV和SysTick重复定义。
873: 
874: ### 11.2 正式AP image provider
875: 
876: 现有打包链在 `copy_binaries_to_pack_dir()`中按照 `apps_info`复制CP/AP：
877: 
878: - `bk_avdk_smp/tools/build_tools/build_process/bk_project.py:145-159`
879: - `bk_avdk_smp/tools/build_tools/build_process/bk_sdk/bk_sdk_project.py:162-175`
880: 
881: 正式改造方式：
882: 
883: 1. 为BK package目标增加 `EXTERNAL_AP_BIN`参数。
884: 2. `bk_sdk_project.py`将AP `app_info.build_bin`替换为该外部输入，或在 `bk_project.py`中按 `app.app_name_in_sdk == "AP"`选择外部输入。
885: 3. CP仍使用正常 `app.bin`。
886: 4. package开始前检查外部AP ELF/raw的hash、大小和build metadata。
887: 5. `copy_binaries_to_pack_dir()`直接把外部AP raw复制到packager需要的AP firmware文件名。
888: 6. 禁止先复制原AP再覆盖临时文件。
889: 7. `bk_build_package.py`继续调用标准packager，不改变最终包格式。
890: 
891: 当前packager执行顺序是先copy再pack：
892: 
893: - `bk_avdk_smp/tools/build_tools/build_process/bk_build_package.py:69-80`
894: 
895: packager从`bk_package.json`的`firmware`字段读取输入文件：
896: 
897: - `bk_avdk_smp/tools/env_tools/bk_py_libs/bk_packager/bk_packager_json.py:44-68`
898: 
899: 因此正式接口必须以生成的JSON和AP role为准，不能硬编码`app1.bin`作为不可变协议。当前工程通常将AP映射为`app1.bin`，但该名称由 `bk_sdk_project.py`产生。
900: 
901: ### 11.3 正式构建目标
902: 
903: 目标依赖关系：
904: 
905: ```text
906: make bk7258_openvela
907:   -> generate partitions and ram_regions
908:   -> build original CPU0 CP
909:   -> build openvela CPU1 AP
910:   -> validate AP ELF/raw
911:   -> external AP image provider
912:   -> package all-app.bin
913:   -> validate final package
914: ```
915: 
916: 原 `bk7258_ap`目标保留为golden/reference构建，但不作为openvela package依赖。这样可以在寄存器、启动向量和mailbox联调时随时生成原AP进行对照。
917: 
918: ### 11.4 自动门禁
919: 
920: 构建必须失败于以下任一条件：
921: 
922: - ELF不是ARMv8-M Mainline Thumb。
923: - CPU属性不是Cortex-M33、hard-float、FPv5-SP-D16。
924: - 出现DSP指令属性。
925: - image offset 0的初始SP不在 `0x28010000..0x28064000`。
926: - reset vector不是Secure Thumb地址。
927: - offset `0x100` magic不正确。
928: - runtime vector未按512字节对齐。
929: - `.data/.bss/.ramfunc/stack/heap`越过 `0x28064000`。
930: - 出现未经批准的PSRAM或CP RAM alloc section。
931: - AP raw超过虚拟AP分区 `0x110000`。
932: - CP/bootloader hash与golden不一致。
933: - final package解码后的AP内容与openvela raw不一致。

960: 
961: 验收：
962: 
963: - CPU1能从 `0x02150000`取vector。
964: - MSP位于AP RAM。
965: - VTOR最终位于RAM runtime vector。
966: - 无HardFault、BusFault、MemManageFault或SecureFault。
967: - 100次CPU1启动无随机失败。
968: 
969: ### 阶段三：完整mailbox v2
970: 
971: 实现并测试：
972: 
973: - MBOX0 FIFO。
974: - CPU1 endpoint。
975: - IRQ63。
976: - 共享buffer pointer/length。
977: - logical channel、sequence、ACK、reset。
978: - PWC transport。
979: 
980: 验收：
981: 
982: - CPU0/CPU1连续完成10000次command/ACK。
983: - 无FIFO full、busy泄漏、sequence错乱和共享buffer覆盖。
984: - CPU1复位后能够清理旧状态并重新同步。
985: 
986: ### 阶段四：NuttX内核和PWC worker
987: 
988: 接入：
989: 
990: - ARMv8-M公共异常和上下文切换。
991: - NuttX IRQ。
992: - heap。
993: - SysTick。
994: - PWC PM worker。
995: - ready发送。
996: 
997: 验收：
998: 
999: - ready P99小于200 ms。
1000: - CP不发生启动重试。
1001: - CP发送PWC命令后，CPU1都能完成transport ACK和语义响应。
1002: - 强制执行CP recovery时，CPU1先quiesce再允许CPU0断电。
1003: 
1004: ### 阶段五：UART1和NSH
1005: 
1006: 实现UART1 lower-half，启动NSH并执行：
1007: 
1008: ```text
1009: help
1010: ps
1011: uptime
1012: free
1013: ```
1014: 
1015: 验收：
1016: 
1017: - UART1收发连续稳定。
1018: - CPU0 UART0仍可独立输出和烧录。
1019: - 高并发日志不破坏mailbox。
1020: - 两个浮点线程上下文切换结果正确。
1021: 
1022: ### 阶段六：PSRAM
1023: 
1024: 完成：
1025: 
1026: - CP power-on通知。
1027: - CPU1 PSRAM状态机。
1028: - NuttX第二heap注册。
1029: - PSRAM使用量统计。
1030: - power-off前清退。
1031: - recovery和重新启动。
1032: 
1033: PSRAM在这一步仍保持non-cacheable。完成72小时压力、掉电恢复和AP recovery测试后，才评估I-cache/D-cache。
1034: 
1035: ### 阶段七：正式package
1036: 
1037: 完成 `EXTERNAL_AP_BIN` provider、ELF/raw/package三层校验和CI构建。
1038: 
1039: 验收：
1040: 
1041: - 一条命令生成最终 `all-app.bin`。
1042: - 空构建目录可重复构建。
1043: - AP image变化不会改变bootloader和CP分区。
1044: - 同一源码和配置重复构建的关键产物一致。
1045: - 现有烧录工具可正常烧录和启动。
1046: 
1047: ## 13. 故障定位顺序
1048: 
1049: ### CPU1无任何输出
1050: 
1051: 检查：
1052: 
1053: 1. CP写入的boot address是否为生成分区对应值。
1054: 2. AP image offset 0的SP和reset vector。
1055: 3. Secure alias是否为 `0x02150000`，没有误用 `0x12150000`。
1056: 4. image offset `0x100` magic。
1057: 5. CPU1 power-down、reset和RXEVT寄存器。
1058: 6. CPU1 JTAG选择：`setjtagmode cpu1 group1`。
1059: 
1060: ### CPU1启动后立即fault
1061: 
1062: 检查：
1063: 
1064: 1. FPU CP10/CP11是否在C代码前启用。
1065: 2. MPU是否覆盖Flash、AP SRAM、PWR_MNG和外设。
1066: 3. VTOR是否已切换到完整RAM vector。
1067: 4. runtime vector是否被magic污染。
1068: 5. SecureFault状态和SAU/IDAU保持是否与CPU0/原CPU1一致。
1069: 
1070: ### CP等待超时
1071: 
1072: 检查：
1073: 
1074: 1. MBOX0 v2初始化是否完成。
1075: 2. CPU1 endpoint是否为 `MAILBOX_CPU1`。
1076: 3. IRQ63和system interrupt group是否打开。
1077: 4. `MB_CHNL_PWC`逻辑channel source/destination是否正确。
1078: 5. pointer/length envelope指向AP共享SRAM。
1079: 6. command/ACK sequence是否匹配。
1080: 7. ready是否在PM worker可用后发送。
1081: 
1082: ### ready后CP命令超时
1083: 
1084: 检查：
1085: 
1086: 1. mailbox ISR是否循环drain RX FIFO。
1087: 2. transport ACK是否及时完成。
1088: 3. PWC命令是否投递给PM worker。
1089: 4. PM worker是否在等待同一个mailbox IRQ或锁，形成死锁。
1090: 5. PSRAM power/malloc/recovery是否按原命令语义返回。
1091: 
1092: ### NSH无输入
1093: 
1094: 检查：
1095: 
1096: 1. GPIO0/1是否仍被AP I2C1占用。
1097: 2. UART1 pinmux和clock。
1098: 3. UART1 IRQ15映射。
1099: 4. `uart_recvchars()`是否被ISR调用。
1100: 5. `/dev/console`是否注册为UART1而不是UART0。
1101: 
1102: ## 14. 仍需取得的正式资料
1103: 
1104: 以下资料是量产和完整安全集成的前置条件，不通过临时实现绕过：
1105:

1141: ## 15. 最终完成定义
1142: 
1143: 完成以下条件，才算完成“openvela 在 BK7258 AP 上的正式初步内核适配”：
1144: 
1145: - CPU0/CP源代码和运行行为保持原样。
1146: - CPU1从AP分区以Secure Cortex-M33启动。
1147: - CPU1使用BK Flash boot vector和独立RAM runtime vector。
1148: - C runtime、FPU、MPU、IRQ和NuttX ARMv8-M上下文切换正常。
1149: - CPU2保持reset，NuttX首版不启用SMP。
1150: - UART1作为CPU1独立控制台工作。

1154: - AP SRAM heap严格限制在 `0x28010000..0x28064000`。
1155: - PSRAM由CP初始化，CPU1按PWC状态使用，不重复初始化PHY。
1156: - 外部AP image通过正式provider进入BK packager，不覆盖临时文件。

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * arch/arm64/src/common/arm64_head.S
3:  *
4:  * Licensed to the Apache Software Foundation (ASF) under one or more
5:  * contributor license agreements.  See the NOTICE file distributed with

10:  *

12:  *
13:  * Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software
14:  * distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS, WITHOUT

17:  * under the License.
18:  *
19:  *    DESCRIPTION
20:  *        Bring-up code for ARMv8.
21:  *        Based on head.S(arm64 porting) at Xen Hypervisor Project
22:  *        Based on reset.S(aarch64 porting) at Zephyr RTOS Project
23:  *
24:  ****************************************************************************/
25: 
26: #include <nuttx/config.h>
27: 
28: #include <arch/chip/chip.h>
29: #include "arm64_arch.h"
30: #include "arm64_internal.h"
31: #include "arm64_macro.inc"
32: 
33: /****************************************************************************
34:  * Public Symbols
35:  ****************************************************************************/
36: 
37:     .file    "arm64_head.S"
38: 
39: /****************************************************************************
40:  * Assembly Macros
41:  ****************************************************************************/
42: 
43: /* macro define from xen head, for efi head define */
44: #define PAGE_SHIFT              12
45: #define __HEAD_FLAG_PAGE_SIZE   ((PAGE_SHIFT - 10) / 2)
46: 
47: #define __HEAD_FLAG_PHYS_BASE   1
48: 
49: 
50: #define __HEAD_FLAGS            ((__HEAD_FLAG_PAGE_SIZE << 1) | \
51:                                  (__HEAD_FLAG_PHYS_BASE << 3))
52: 
53: #ifdef CONFIG_ARCH_EARLY_PRINT
54: 
55: #define RODATA_STR(label, msg)                  \
56: .pushsection .rodata.str, "aMS", %progbits, 1 ; \
57: label:  .asciz msg;                             \
58: .popsection
59: 
60: /* Macro to print a string to the UART, if there is one.
61:  * Clobbers x0 - x3, x30 is lr for return
62:  */
63: #define PRINT(sym, _s)            \
64:     mov   x3, x30 ;                \
65:     ldr   x1, =boot_string_##sym ; \
66:     bl    boot_stage_puts;         \
67:     mov   x30, x3 ;                \
68:     RODATA_STR(boot_string_##sym, _s)
69: #else
70: #define PRINT(sym, s)
71: #endif /* CONFIG_ARCH_EARLY_PRINT */
72: 
73: /****************************************************************************
74:  * Private Functions
75:  ****************************************************************************/
76: 
77: /****************************************************************************
78:  * Public Functions
79:  ****************************************************************************/
80: 
81:     /* Kernel startup entry point.
82:      * ---------------------------
83:      *
84:      * The requirements are:
85:      *   MMU = off, D-cache = off, I-cache = on or off,
86:      *   x0 = physical address to the FDT blob.
87:      *       it will be used when NuttX support device tree in the future
88:      *
89:      * This must be the very first address in the loaded image.
90:      * It should be loaded at any 4K-aligned address.
91:      */
92: 
93:     .section .start, "ax"
94:     .globl __start;
95: __start:
96: 
97:     /* DO NOT MODIFY. Image header expected by Linux boot-loaders.
98:      *
99:      * This add instruction has no meaningful effect except that
100:      * its opcode forms the magic "MZ" signature of a PE/COFF file
101:      * that is required for UEFI applications.
102:      *
103:      * Some bootloader (such imx8 uboot) checking the magic "MZ" to see
104:      * if the image is a valid Linux image. but modifying the bootLoader is
105:      * unnecessary unless we need to do a customize secure boot.
106:      * so just put the ''MZ" in the header to make bootloader happiness
107:      */
108: 
109:     add     x13, x18, #0x16      /* the magic "MZ" signature */
110:     b       real_start           /* branch to kernel start */
111:     .quad   0x480000              /* Image load offset from start of RAM */
112:     .quad   _e_initstack - __start         /* Effective size of kernel image, little-endian */
113:     .quad   __HEAD_FLAGS         /* Informative flags, little-endian */
114:     .quad   0                    /* reserved */
115:     .quad   0                    /* reserved */
116:     .quad   0                    /* reserved */
117:     .ascii  "ARM\x64"            /* Magic number, "ARM\x64" */
118:     .long   0                    /* reserved */
119: 
120: real_start:
121:     /* Disable all exceptions and interrupts */
122: 
123:     msr    DAIFSet, 0xf
124: #ifndef CONFIG_UP
125:     get_cpu_id x1
126: 
127:     /* The global variable cpu_boot_params is not safety to
128:      * access in some case. eg. Some debugger will reboot
129:      * the NuttX but not reload the whole image, so it will
130:      * be not predicable for the initial value of the global
131:      * value in that case
132:      *
133:      * get_cpu_id is safety because the CPU identification is
134:      * not change in any case, so the code will judge in a
135:      * very simple method:
136:      *  -- Primary core will go on until it want to boot the
137:      *     other core. For NuttX OS usage case, we can consider
138:      *     the CPU id (the affinity of mpidr_el1) of primary
139:      *     core is always 0.
140:      *  -- The other cores will waiting until the primary
141:      *     core write mpid and notify it to go on
142:      */
143: 
144:     cmp    x1, #0
145:     beq    primary_core
146: 
147:     /* we can now load our stack pointer value and move on */
148: 
149:     ldr    x24, =g_cpu_idlestackalloc
150: 
151:     /* g_cpu_idlestackalloc represents a continuous
152:      * stack space allocated for CPUs from 0 to n.
153:      * the stack top address for each CPU based on
154:      * its index,x24 is the top of the stack for CPUs 0 to n.
155:      */
156: 1:
157:     sub    x1, x1, #1
158:     add    x24, x24, #(CONFIG_IDLETHREAD_STACKSIZE)
159:     cmp    x1, #0
160:     bne    1b
161: 
162: #  ifdef CONFIG_STACK_COLORATION
163:     /* Write a known value to the IDLE thread stack to support stack
164:      * monitoring logic
165:      */
166: 
167:     ldr    w1, =STACK_WORDS
168:     ldr    w2, =STACK_COLOR
169: 
170: .loop:
171:     sub    w1, w1, #1
172:     str    w2, [x24], #4
173:     cmp    w1, #0
174:     bne    .loop
175: #  else
176:     add    x24, x24, #(CONFIG_IDLETHREAD_STACKSIZE)
177: #  endif
178: 
179:     /* Initialize percpu reg */
180: 
181:     msr    tpidr_el1, xzr
182:     msr    tpidr_el0, xzr
183:     msr    tpidrro_el0, xzr
184:     ldr    x25, =arm64_boot_secondary_c_routine
185:     bl     __reset_prep_c
186: 
187:     PRINT(second_boot, "- Ready to Boot Second CPU\r\n")
188: 
189:     b      cpu_boot
190: 
191: primary_core:
192:     ldr    x24, =g_cpu_idlestackalloc
193: 
194:     add    x24, x24, #(CONFIG_IDLETHREAD_STACKSIZE)
195: #else
196:     /* In some case, we need to boot one core in a SMP system,
197:      * To avoid the primary core disturbed by the other cores,
198:      * we need keep the other cores into WFE loop
199:      */
200:     get_cpu_id x1
201:     cmp    x1, #0
202:     bne    fail
203: 
204:     /* load stack and entry point */
205: 
206:     ldr    x24, =(g_cpu_idlestackalloc + CONFIG_IDLETHREAD_STACKSIZE)
207: #endif /* CONFIG_SMP */
208: 
209:     /* Initialize percpu reg */
210: 
211:     msr    tpidr_el1, xzr
212:     msr    tpidr_el0, xzr
213:     msr    tpidrro_el0, xzr
214:     ldr    x25, =arm64_boot_primary_c_routine
215: 
216:     /* Prepare for calling C code */
217: 
218:     bl     __reset_prep_c
219: 
220: #ifndef CONFIG_ARCH_SKIP_ZERO_BSS
221:     bl    arm64_data_initialize
222: #endif
223: 
224:     PRINT(primary_boot, "- Ready to Boot Primary CPU\r\n")
225: 
226: cpu_boot:
227: 
228:     /* Platform hook for highest EL */
229: 
230:     bl  arm64_el_init
231: 
232: switch_el:
233:     switch_el x0, 3f, 2f, 1f
234: 3:
235: #ifdef CONFIG_ARCH_HAVE_EL3
236:     PRINT(switch_el3, "- Boot from EL3\r\n")
237: 
238:     /* EL3 init */
239: 
240:     bl    arm64_boot_el3_init
241: 
242: #if CONFIG_ARCH_ARM64_EXCEPTION_LEVEL == 3
243:     msr   SPSel, #1
244: 
245:     /* Set SP_EL3 (with SPSel = 1) */
246: 
247:     mov   sp, x24
248:     b     el3_boot
249: #endif
250: 
251:     /* Get next EL */
252: 
253:     adr   x0, switch_el
254:     bl    arm64_boot_el3_get_next_el
255:     eret
256: #endif
257: 2:
258:     PRINT(switch_el2, "- Boot from EL2\r\n")
259: 
260:     /* EL2 init */
261: 
262:     bl    arm64_boot_el2_init
263: 
264:     /* Move to EL1 with all exceptions masked */
265: 
266:     mov_imm    x0, (SPSR_DAIF_MASK | SPSR_MODE_EL1T)
267:     msr   spsr_el2, x0
268: 
269:     adr   x0, 1f
270:     msr   elr_el2, x0
271:     eret
272: 
273: 1:
274:     PRINT(switch_el1, "- Boot from EL1\r\n")
275: 
276:     /* EL1 init */
277: 
278:     bl    arm64_boot_el1_init
279: 
280:     /* set SP_ELx and Enable SError interrupts */
281: 
282:     msr   SPSel, #1
283:     msr   DAIFClr, #(DAIFCLR_ABT_BIT)
284: 
285: el3_boot:
286:     isb
287: 
288: jump_to_c_entry:
289:     PRINT(jump_to_c_entry, "- Boot to C runtime for OS Initialize\r\n")
290:     ret x25
291: 
292: /* Fail-stop */
293: 
294: fail:
295:     /* Boot failed */
296: 
297: 1:  wfe
298:     b     1b
299: 
300: /* Set the minimum necessary to safely call C code */
301: 
302: __reset_prep_c:
303: 
304:     /* return address: x23 */
305: 
306:     mov   x23, lr
307: 
308:     switch_el x0, 3f, 2f, 1f
309: 3:
310: #ifdef CONFIG_ARCH_HAVE_EL3
311:     /* Reinitialize SCTLR from scratch in EL3 */
312: 
313:     ldr   w0, =(SCTLR_EL3_RES1 | SCTLR_SA_BIT)
314:     msr   sctlr_el3, x0
315: #endif
316: 
317:     /* Set SP_EL1 */
318: 
319:     msr   sp_el1, x24
320:     b     out
321: 2:
322:     /* Disable alignment fault checking */
323: 
324:     mrs   x0, sctlr_el2
325:     bic   x0, x0, SCTLR_A_BIT
326:     msr   sctlr_el2, x0
327: 
328:     /* Set SP_EL1 */
329: 
330:     msr   sp_el1, x24
331:     b     out
332: 1:
333:     /* Disable alignment fault checking */
334: 
335:     mrs   x0, sctlr_el1
336:     bic   x0, x0, SCTLR_A_BIT
337:     msr   sctlr_el1, x0
338: 
339:     /* Set SP_EL1. We cannot use sp_el1 at EL1 */
340: 
341:     msr   SPSel, #1
342:     mov   sp, x24
343: out:
344:     isb
345: 
346:     /* Select SP_EL0 and Initialize stack */
347: 
348:     msr   SPSel, #0
349:     mov   sp, x24
350: 
351:     ret   x23
352: 
353: #ifdef CONFIG_ARCH_EARLY_PRINT
354: 
355: /* Print early debug messages.
356:  * x0: Nul-terminated string to print.
357:  * Clobbers x0-x1
358:  */
359: 
360: boot_stage_puts:
361:     stp   xzr, x30, [sp, #-16]!
362: 1:
363:     ldrb  w0, [x1], #1       /* Load next char */
364:     cmp   w0, 0
365:     beq   2f                 /* Exit on nul */
366:     bl    arm64_lowputc
367:     b     1b                 /* Loop */
368: 2:
369:     ldp   xzr, x30, [sp], #16
370:     ret
371: 
372: .type boot_stage_puts, %function;
373: 
374: #endif /* !CONFIG_ARCH_EARLY_PRINT */
375:

380:  ***************************************************************************/

382:     .type   arm64_data_initialize, #function
383: 
384: arm64_data_initialize:
385: 
386:     /* Zero BSS */
387: 
388:     adrp    x0, .Linitparms
389:     add     x0, x0, #:lo12:.Linitparms
390:     ldp     x1, x2, [x0], #8
391: 
392:     mov     x0, #0
393: 1:
394:     cmp     x1, x2
395:     bge     2f
396:     str     x0, [x1], #8
397:     b       1b
398: 2:
399:     ret

51: /* Some ARM aarch64 Cortex-family processors have not EL3
52:  * these two function should never called
53:  * defined to available compile error when with gcc option
54:  */
55: 
56: void arm64_boot_el3_init(void)
57: {
58:   uint64_t reg;
59: 
60: #ifndef CONFIG_ARM64_ICACHE_DISABLE
61:   reg = read_sysreg(sctlr_el3);
62:   reg |= SCTLR_I_BIT;
63:   write_sysreg(reg, sctlr_el3);
64: #endif
65: 
66:   /* Setup vector table */
67: 
68:   write_sysreg((uint64_t)_vector_table, vbar_el3);
69:   UP_ISB();
70: 
71:   reg = 0U;                   /* Mostly RES0 */
72:   reg &= ~(CPTR_TTA_BIT |     /* Do not trap sysreg accesses */
73:            CPTR_TFP_BIT |     /* Do not trap SVE, SIMD and FP */
74:            CPTR_TCPAC_BIT);   /* Do not trap CPTR_EL2 CPACR_EL1 accesses */
75: 
76:   /* CPTR_EL3, Architectural Feature Trap Register (EL3) */
77: 
78:   write_sysreg(reg, cptr_el3);
79: 
80:   reg = 0U;               /* Reset */
81:   reg |= SCR_NS_BIT;      /* EL2 / EL3 non-secure */
82:   reg |= (SCR_RES1 |      /* RES1 */
83: #if CONFIG_ARCH_ARM64_EXCEPTION_LEVEL == 3
84:           SCR_IRQ_BIT |   /* Route IRQs to EL3 */
85:           SCR_FIQ_BIT |   /* Route FIQs to EL3 */
86:           SCR_EA_BIT |    /* Route EAs to EL3 */
87: #endif
88:           SCR_RW_BIT |    /* EL2 execution state is AArch64 */
89:           SCR_ST_BIT |    /* Do not trap EL1 accesses to timer */
90:           SCR_HCE_BIT |   /* Do not trap HVC */
91:           SCR_SMD_BIT);   /* Do not trap SMC */
92:   write_sysreg(reg, scr_el3);
93: 
94: #if CONFIG_ARM64_GIC_VERSION > 2
95:   reg = read_sysreg(ICC_SRE_EL3);
96:   reg |= (ICC_SRE_ELX_DFB_BIT |   /* Disable FIQ bypass */
97:           ICC_SRE_ELX_DIB_BIT |   /* Disable IRQ bypass */
98:           ICC_SRE_ELX_SRE_BIT |   /* System register interface is used */
99:           ICC_SRE_EL3_EN_BIT);    /* Enables lower Exception level access to
100:                                    * ICC_SRE_EL1 */
101:   write_sysreg(reg, ICC_SRE_EL3);
102: #endif
103: 
104:   UP_ISB();
105: }
106: 
107: void arm64_boot_el3_get_next_el(uint64_t switch_addr)
108: {
109:   uint64_t spsr;
110: 
111:   write_sysreg(switch_addr, elr_el3);
112: 
113:   /* Mask the DAIF */
114: 
115:   spsr = SPSR_DAIF_MASK;
116:   spsr |= SPSR_MODE_EL2T;
117: 
118:   write_sysreg(spsr, spsr_el3);
119: }
120: #endif
121: 
122: void arm64_boot_el2_init(void)
123: {
124:   uint64_t reg;
125: 
126:   /* Before we disable dcache, we should flush all dcache. */
127: 
128:   up_flush_dcache_all();
129: 
130:   reg = 0U;                   /* RES0 */
131:   reg = (SCTLR_EL2_RES1 |     /* RES1 */
132: #ifndef CONFIG_ARM64_ICACHE_DISABLE
133:          SCTLR_I_BIT |        /* Enable i-cache */
134: #endif
135:          SCTLR_SA_BIT);       /* Enable SP alignment check */
136:   write_sysreg(reg, sctlr_el2);
137: 
138: #ifdef CONFIG_ARCH_CLUSTER_PMU
139:   reg = read_sysreg(actlr_el2);
140:   reg |= ACTLR_CLPMU_BIT;
141:   write_sysreg(reg, actlr_el2);
142: #endif
143: 
144:   reg = read_sysreg(hcr_el2);
145:   reg |= HCR_RW_BIT;      /* EL1 Execution state is AArch64 */
146: 
147: #ifdef CONFIG_ARM64_MTE
148:   reg |= HCR_ATA_BIT;
149: #endif
150: 
151:   write_sysreg(reg, hcr_el2);
152: 
153:   reg = 0U;                   /* RES0 */
154:   reg |= CPTR_EL2_RES1;       /* RES1 */
155:   reg &= ~(CPTR_TFP_BIT |     /* Do not trap SVE, SIMD and FP */
156:            CPTR_TCPAC_BIT);   /* Do not trap CPACR_EL1 accesses */
157:   write_sysreg(reg, cptr_el2);
158: 
159:   /* Enable EL1 access to timers */
160: 
161:   reg = read_sysreg(cnthctl_el2);
162:   reg |= (CNTHCTL_EL2_EL1PCEN_EN | CNTHCTL_EL2_EL1PCTEN_EN);
163:   write_sysreg(reg, cnthctl_el2);
164: 
165:   zero_sysreg(cntvoff_el2);       /* Set 64-bit virtual timer offset to 0 */
166: 
167: #ifdef CONFIG_ARCH_ARMV8R
168:   zero_sysreg(cnthps_ctl_el2);
169: #else
170:   zero_sysreg(cnthp_ctl_el2);
171: #endif
172: 
173: #ifdef CONFIG_ARCH_SET_VMPIDR_EL2
174:   reg = read_sysreg(mpidr_el1);
175:   write_sysreg(reg, vmpidr_el2);
176: #endif
177: 
178:   /* Enable this if/when we use the hypervisor timer.
179:    * write_cnthp_cval_el2(~(uint64_t)0);
180:    */
181: 
182:   UP_ISB();
183: }
184: 
185: void arm64_boot_el1_init(void)
186: {
187:   uint64_t reg;
188: 
189:   /* Setup vector table */
190: 
191:   write_sysreg((uint64_t)_vector_table, vbar_el1);
192:   UP_ISB();
193: 
194:   reg = 0U;                       /* RES0 */
195:   reg |= CPACR_EL1_FPEN_NOTRAP;   /* Do not trap NEON/SIMD/FP initially */
196: 
197:   /* TODO: CONFIG_FLOAT_*_FORBIDDEN */
198: 
199:   write_sysreg(reg, cpacr_el1);
200: 
201:   /* Before we disable dcache, we should flush all dcache. */
202: 
203:   up_flush_dcache_all();
204: 
205:   reg = 0U;                   /* RES0 */
206:   reg = (SCTLR_EL1_RES1 |     /* RES1 */
207: #ifndef CONFIG_ARM64_ICACHE_DISABLE
208:          SCTLR_I_BIT |        /* Enable i-cache */
209: #endif
210:          SCTLR_SA_BIT);       /* Enable SP alignment check */
211:   write_sysreg(reg, sctlr_el1);
212: 
213:   write_sysreg((~(uint64_t)0), cntv_cval_el0);
214: 
215:   /* Enable these if/when we use the corresponding timers.
216:    * write_cntp_cval_el0(~(uint64_t)0);
217:    * write_cntps_cval_el1(~(uint64_t)0);
218:    */
219: 
220:   UP_ISB();
221: }

224: {
225:   arm64_chip_boot();
226:   nx_start();

183: /****************************************************************************
184:  * Name: up_cpu_start
185:  *
186:  * Description:
187:  *   In an SMP configuration, only one CPU is initially active (CPU 0).
188:  *   System initialization occurs on that single thread. At the completion of
189:  *   the initialization of the OS, just before beginning normal multitasking,
190:  *   the additional CPUs would be started by calling this function.
191:  *
192:  *   Each CPU is provided the entry point to its IDLE task when started.  A
193:  *   TCB for each CPU's IDLE task has been initialized and placed in the
194:  *   CPU's g_assignedtasks[cpu] list.  No stack has been allocated or
195:  *   initialized.
196:  *
197:  *   The OS initialization logic calls this function repeatedly until each
198:  *   CPU has been started, 1 through (CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS-1).
199:  *
200:  * Input Parameters:
201:  *   cpu - The index of the CPU being started.  This will be a numeric
202:  *         value in the range of one to (CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS-1).
203:  *         (CPU 0 is already active)
204:  *
205:  * Returned Value:
206:  *   Zero on success; a negated errno value on failure.
207:  *
208:  ****************************************************************************/
209: 
210: int up_cpu_start(int cpu)
211: {
212:   DEBUGASSERT(cpu >= 0 && cpu < CONFIG_NCPUS && cpu != this_cpu());
213: 
214: #ifdef CONFIG_SCHED_INSTRUMENTATION
215: 
216:   /* Notify of the start event */
217: 
218:   sched_note_cpu_start(this_task(), cpu);
219: #endif
220: 
221:   arm64_start_cpu(cpu);
222: 
223:   return 0;
224: }

1: # BEKEN 芯片 openvela 支持
2: 
3: [ [English](README.md) | 简体中文 ]
4: 
5: ## 简介
6: 
7: 本仓库包含 BEKEN（博通集成）为 openvela 操作系统提供的芯片支持、板级配置
8: 及硬件驱动。BEKEN 是一家专注于 AIoT 领域 Wi-Fi 与蓝牙等无线连接芯片的厂商。
9: 
10: 当前移植目标为 **BK7236N** SoC，并通过
11: `chips/bk7236n/bk_idk/armino_as_lib/` 下的预编译库与头文件集成 BEKEN Armino
12: SDK。
13: 
14: > 注意：本工作区中的目录名是 `vendor_beken`，不是 `vendor/beken`。以下路径均以
15: > openvela 工作区根目录为基准。
16: 
17: ## 仓库结构
18: 
19: ```
20: vendor_beken/
21: ├── boards/                  # 板级配置
22: │   └── bk7236n/
23: │       └── bk7236n-evb/     # BK7236N 评估板
24: ├── chips/                   # 芯片支持与硬件抽象层
25: │   └── bk7236n/             # BK7236N 芯片移植
26: │       ├── bk_idk/
27: │       │   └── armino_as_lib/  # 预编译 Armino SDK 库与头文件
28: │       └── bootloader.bin     # 预编译 Bootloader 二进制
29: ├── tools/
30: │   └── cmake_encrypt_crc      # 预编译构建后 CRC 工具
31: ├── LICENSE                    # 仓库许可证
32: └── LICENSE-NOTES.md           # 预编译二进制许可说明
33: ```
34: 
35: ## 支持的硬件
36: 
37: ### BK7236N
38: 
39: **BK7236N** 是一款面向 AIoT 设备的 Wi-Fi / 蓝牙 SoC，主要特性包括：
40: 
41: - **处理器**：Arm®v8-M STAR-MC1 MCU
42: - **无线连接**：集成 Wi-Fi 6 与 BLE 5.4
43: - **应用场景**：智能家居、无线模组及嵌入式连接设备等
44: 
45: ### 开发板
46: 
47: BK7236N 官方评估板配置位于 `boards/bk7236n/bk7236n-evb/`。
48: 
49: ## 与 openvela 的集成
50: 
51: openvela 是面向 AIoT 应用的嵌入式操作系统。本芯片 vendor 仓库通过以下方式
52: 与 openvela 集成：
53: 
54: 1. **Kconfig 集成**：通过 `menuconfig` 配置芯片与板级选项
55: 2. **构建系统**：NuttX/openvela CMake 与 Makefile 构建基础设施
56: 3. **设备驱动**：标准 NuttX lower-half 驱动接口
57: 4. **Armino SDK**：NuttX 构建过程中链接预编译静态库；当前以 openvela/NuttX
58:    为唯一内核，`beken_os_adapt.c` 将 Armino OS API 映射到 NuttX API，并非
59:    FreeRTOS 与 NuttX 共存
60: 
61: ## 配置与构建
62: 
63: 配置 BK7236N 评估板 NSH 方案：
64: 
65: ```bash
66: # 在 openvela 工作区根目录执行
67: ./build.sh vendor_beken/boards/bk7236n/bk7236n-evb/configs/nsh
68: 
69: # CMake 构建（可选）
70: ./build.sh vendor_beken/boards/bk7236n/bk7236n-evb/configs/nsh --cmake
71: ```
72: 
73: 完成配置后，可通过 `menuconfig` 自定义功能：
74: 
75: ```bash
76: make -C nuttx menuconfig
77: ```
78: 
79: 构建完成后，vendor 后处理会先对 `nuttx.bin` 执行
80: `tools/cmake_encrypt_crc -crc`，生成 `nuttx_crc.bin`，再将
81: `chips/bk7236n/bootloader.bin` 与其拼接为 `all-app.bin`。这里的 CRC 只提供
82: 完整性校验，不等于密码学安全启动。
83: 
84: ## 安全能力边界
85: 
86: `bk_idk/projects/security/secureboot_xip` 中有 BK7236 安全启动、TF-M、OTP/EFUSE
87: 和安全 OTA 示例，但当前 vendor 目录没有配套的 BL1/BL2/TF-M 镜像、签名工具、
88: 密钥/公钥配置、`otp_efuse_config.json` 或安全 OTA 打包流程。因此当前仓库只能
89: 确认普通启动和 CRC 后处理，不能宣称已支持安全启动、安全升级或 Flash AES 加密。
90: 
91: 要实现这些能力，必须先取得 Beken 针对 BK7236N、实际 Flash 容量和当前 openvela
92: 分区布局的安全启动交付物及 OTP/EFUSE 文档，再将安全镜像链路、签名打包、版本

83:  *   unexpected interrupt handler is that they provide a diagnostic output.
84:  *
85:  ****************************************************************************/
86: 
87: static int bk7236_nmi(int irq, void *context, void *arg)
88: {
89:   uint32_t msp_val, lr_val;
90:   up_irq_save();
91:   bk_misc_set_reset_reason(RESET_SOURCE_NMI_WDT);
92:   __asm__ volatile (
93:       "MRS %0, msp      \n"
94:       "MOV %1, lr       \n"
95:       "push {r4-r11}    \n"
96:       : "=r" (msp_val), "=r" (lr_val)
97:   );
98:   user_nmi_handler(lr_val, msp_val);
99:   while(1);
100:   return 0;
101: }
102: 
103: static int bk7236_pendsv(int irq, void *context, void *arg)
104: {
105:   up_irq_save();
106:   _err("PANIC!!! PendSV received\n");
107:   PANIC();
108:   return 0;
109: }
110: 
111: static int bk7236_reserved(int irq, void *context, void *arg)
112: {
113:   up_irq_save();
114:   _err("PANIC!!! Reserved interrupt\n");
115:   PANIC();
116:   return 0;
117: }

119: /****************************************************************************
120:  * Name: bk7236_prioritize_syscall
121:  *
122:  * Description:
123:  *   Set the SVCall exception priority.  This must be higher than
124:  *   NVIC_SYSH_DISABLE_PRIORITY so that context switches via SVC still work
125:  *   while enter_critical_section() has raised BASEPRI.
126:  *
127:  ****************************************************************************/
128: 
129: static inline void bk7236_prioritize_syscall(int priority)
130: {
131:   uint32_t regval;
132: 
133:   /* SVCALL is system handler 11 */
134: 
135:   regval  = getreg32(NVIC_SYSH8_11_PRIORITY);
136:   regval &= ~NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_PR11_MASK;
137:   regval |= (priority << NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_PR11_SHIFT);
138:   putreg32(regval, NVIC_SYSH8_11_PRIORITY);
139: }
140: 
141: /****************************************************************************
142:  * Name: bk7236_irqinfo
143:  *
144:  * Description:
145:  *   Given an IRQ number, provide the register and bit setting to enable or
146:  *   disable the irq.
147:  *
148:  ****************************************************************************/
149: 
150: static int bk7236_irqinfo(int irq, uintptr_t *regaddr, uint32_t *bit,
151:                          uintptr_t offset)
152: {
153:   int n;
154: 
155:   DEBUGASSERT(irq >= BK7236N_IRQ_NMI && irq < NR_IRQS);
156: 
157:   /* Check for external interrupt */
158: 
159:   if (irq >= BK7236N_IRQ_FIRST)
160:     {
161:       n        = irq - BK7236N_IRQ_FIRST;
162:       *regaddr = NVIC_IRQ_ENABLE(n) + offset;
163:       *bit     = (uint32_t)1 << (n & 0x1f);
164:     }
165: 
166:   /* Handle processor exceptions.  Only a few can be disabled */
167: 
168:   else
169:     {
170:       *regaddr = NVIC_SYSHCON;
171:       if (irq == BK7236N_IRQ_MEMFAULT)
172:         {
173:           *bit = NVIC_SYSHCON_MEMFAULTENA;
174:         }
175:       else if (irq == BK7236N_IRQ_BUSFAULT)
176:         {
177:           *bit = NVIC_SYSHCON_BUSFAULTENA;
178:         }
179:       else if (irq == BK7236N_IRQ_USAGEFAULT)
180:         {
181:           *bit = NVIC_SYSHCON_USGFAULTENA;
182:         }
183:       else if (irq == BK7236N_IRQ_SYSTICK)
184:         {
185:           *regaddr = NVIC_SYSTICK_CTRL;
186:           *bit = NVIC_SYSTICK_CTRL_ENABLE;
187:         }
188:       else
189:         {
190:           return ERROR; /* Invalid or unsupported exception */
191:         }
192:     }
193: 
194:   return OK;
195: }
196: 
197: /****************************************************************************
198:  * Public Functions
199:  ****************************************************************************/
200: 
201: /****************************************************************************
202:  * Name: up_irqinitialize
203:  ****************************************************************************/
204: 
205: void up_irqinitialize(void)
206: {
207:   uint32_t regaddr;
208:   int num_priority_registers;
209:   int i;
210: 
211:   /* Disable all interrupts */
212: 
213:   for (i = 0; i < NR_IRQS - BK7236N_IRQ_FIRST; i += 32)
214:     {
215:       putreg32(0xffffffff, NVIC_IRQ_CLEAR(i));
216:     }
217: 
218: #ifdef CONFIG_ARCH_RAMVECTORS
219:   /* If CONFIG_ARCH_RAMVECTORS is defined, then we are using a RAM-based
220:    * vector table that requires special initialization.
221:    */
222:   arm_ramvec_initialize();
223: #endif
224: 
225:   /* Set all interrupts (and exceptions) to the default priority */
226: 
227:   putreg32(DEFPRIORITY32, NVIC_SYSH4_7_PRIORITY);
228:   putreg32(DEFPRIORITY32, NVIC_SYSH8_11_PRIORITY);
229:   putreg32(DEFPRIORITY32, NVIC_SYSH12_15_PRIORITY);
230: 
231:   /* The NVIC ICTR register (bits 0-4) holds the number of interrupt
232:    * lines that the NVIC supports:
233:    *
234:    *  0 -> 32 interrupt lines,  8 priority registers
235:    *  1 -> 64 "       " "   ", 16 priority registers
236:    *  2 -> 96 "       " "   ", 32 priority registers
237:    *  ...
238:    */
239: 
240:   num_priority_registers = (getreg32(NVIC_ICTR) + 1) * 8;
241: 
242:   /* Now set all of the interrupt lines to the default priority */
243:   regaddr = NVIC_IRQ0_3_PRIORITY;
244:   while (num_priority_registers--)
245:     {
246:       putreg32(DEFPRIORITY32, regaddr);
247:       regaddr += 4;
248:     }
249: 
250:   /* Attach the SVCall and Hard Fault exception handlers */
251:   irq_attach(BK7236N_IRQ_SVCALL, arm_svcall, NULL);
252:   irq_attach(BK7236N_IRQ_HARDFAULT, arm_hardfault, NULL);
253: 
254:   /* SVCall must preempt BASEPRI masked critical sections for context switch */
255: 
256:   bk7236_prioritize_syscall(NVIC_SYSH_SVCALL_PRIORITY);
257: 
258:   /* If the MPU is enabled, then attach and enable the Memory Management
259:    * Fault handler.
260:    */
261: 
262: #ifdef CONFIG_ARM_MPU
263:   irq_attach(BK7236N_IRQ_MEMFAULT, arm_memfault, NULL);
264:   up_enable_irq(BK7236N_IRQ_MEMFAULT);
265: #endif
266:   /* Attach all other processor exceptions (except reset and sys tick) */
267: 
268:   irq_attach(BK7236N_IRQ_NMI, bk7236_nmi, NULL);
269: #ifndef CONFIG_ARM_MPU
270:   irq_attach(BK7236N_IRQ_MEMFAULT, arm_memfault, NULL);
271: #endif
272:   irq_attach(BK7236N_IRQ_BUSFAULT, arm_busfault, NULL);
273:   irq_attach(BK7236N_IRQ_USAGEFAULT, arm_usagefault, NULL);
274:   irq_attach(BK7236N_IRQ_PENDSV, bk7236_pendsv, NULL);
275:   arm_enable_dbgmonitor();
276:   irq_attach(BK7236N_IRQ_DBGMONITOR, arm_dbgmonitor, NULL);
277:   irq_attach(BK7236N_IRQ_RESERVED, bk7236_reserved, NULL);
278: 
279:   /* Enable interrupts */
280:   up_irq_enable();
281: }

283: /****************************************************************************
284:  * Name: up_enable_irq
285:  *
286:  * Description:
287:  *   Enable the interrupt specified by 'irq'
288:  *
289:  ****************************************************************************/
290: 
291: void up_enable_irq(int irq)
292: {
293:   uintptr_t regaddr;
294:   uint32_t regval;
295:   uint32_t bit;
296: 
297:   if (bk7236_irqinfo(irq, &regaddr, &bit, NVIC_ENA_OFFSET) == 0)
298:     {
299:       /* Modify the appropriate bit in the register to enable the interrupt.
300:        * For normal interrupts, we need to set the bit in the associated
301:        * Interrupt Set Enable register.  For other exceptions, we need to
302:        * set the bit in the System Handler Control and State Register.
303:        */
304: 
305:       if (irq >= BK7236N_IRQ_FIRST)
306:         {
307:           putreg32(bit, regaddr);
308:         }
309:       else
310:         {
311:           regval  = getreg32(regaddr);
312:           regval |= bit;
313:           putreg32(regval, regaddr);
314:         }
315:     }
316: }
317: 
318: /****************************************************************************
319:  * Name: up_disable_irq
320:  *
321:  * Description:
322:  *   Disable the interrupt specified by 'irq'
323:  *
324:  ****************************************************************************/
325: 
326: void up_disable_irq(int irq)
327: {
328:   uintptr_t regaddr;
329:   uint32_t regval;
330:   uint32_t bit;
331: 
332:   if (bk7236_irqinfo(irq, &regaddr, &bit, NVIC_CLRENA_OFFSET) == 0)
333:     {
334:       /* Modify the appropriate bit in the register to disable the interrupt.
335:        * For normal interrupts, we need to set the bit in the associated
336:        * Interrupt Clear Enable register.  For other exceptions, we need to
337:        * clear the bit in the System Handler Control and State Register.
338:        */
339: 
340:       if (irq >= BK7236N_IRQ_FIRST)
341:         {
342:           putreg32(bit, regaddr);
343:         }
344:       else
345:         {
346:           regval  = getreg32(regaddr);
347:           regval &= ~bit;
348:           putreg32(regval, regaddr);
349:         }
350:     }
351: }
352:

354:  * Name: arm_ack_irq
355:  *
356:  * Description:
357:  *   Acknowledge the IRQ
358:  *
359:  ****************************************************************************/
360: 
361: void arm_ack_irq(int irq)
362: {
363:

366: /****************************************************************************
367:  * Name: up_prioritize_irq
368:  *
369:  * Description:
370:  *   Set the priority of an IRQ.
371:  *
372:  *   Since this API is not supported on all architectures, it should be
373:  *   avoided in common implementations where possible.
374:  *
375:  ****************************************************************************/
376: 
377: #ifdef CONFIG_ARCH_IRQPRIO
378: int up_prioritize_irq(int irq, int priority)
379: {
380:   uint32_t regaddr;
381:   uint32_t regval;
382:   int shift;
383: 
384:   DEBUGASSERT(irq >= BK7236N_IRQ_MEMFAULT && irq < NR_IRQS &&
385:             (unsigned)priority <= NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_MIN);
386: 
387:   if (irq < BK7236N_IRQ_FIRST)
388:     {
389:       /* NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY() maps {0..15} to one of three priority
390:        * registers (0-3 are invalid)
391:        */
392: 
393:       regaddr = NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY(irq);
394:       irq    -= 4;
395:     }
396:   else
397:     {
398:       /* NVIC_IRQ_PRIORITY() maps {0..} to one of many priority registers */
399: 
400:       irq    -= BK7236N_IRQ_FIRST;
401:       regaddr = NVIC_IRQ_PRIORITY(irq);
402:     }
403: 
404:   regval      = getreg32(regaddr);
405:   shift       = ((irq & 3) << 3);
406:   regval     &= ~(0xff << shift);
407:   regval     |= (priority << shift);
408:   putreg32(regval, regaddr);
409: 
410:   return OK;
411: }
412: #endif

133:   if (intid < GIC_SPI_INT_BASE)
134:     {
135:       base        = (gic_get_rdist() + GICR_CTLR);
136:       rwp_mask    = BIT(GICR_CTLR_RWP);
137:     }
138:   else
139:     {
140:       base        = GICD_CTLR;
141:       rwp_mask    = BIT(GICD_CTLR_RWP);
142:     }
143: 
144:   while (getreg32(base) & rwp_mask)
145:     {
146:     }
147: 
148:   return 0;
149: }

158: /***************************************************************************
159:  * Name: up_set_irq_type
160:  *
161:  * Description:
162:  *   Set the trigger type for the specified IRQ source and the current CPU.
163:  *
164:  *   Since this API is not supported on all architectures, it should be
165:  *   avoided in common implementations where possible.
166:  *
167:  * Input Parameters:
168:  *   irq  - The interrupt request to modify.
169:  *   mode - Level sensitive or edge sensitive
170:  *
171:  * Returned Value:
172:  *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value is returned on any failure.
173:  *
174:  ***************************************************************************/
175: 
176: int up_set_irq_type(int irq, int mode)
177: {
178:   uint32_t      idx  = irq / GIC_NUM_INTR_PER_REG;
179:   uint32_t      shift;
180:   uint32_t      val;
181:   unsigned long base = GET_DIST_BASE(irq);
182: 
183:   if (!GIC_IS_SGI(irq))
184:     {
185:       idx   = irq / GIC_NUM_CFG_PER_REG;
186:       shift = (irq & (GIC_NUM_CFG_PER_REG - 1)) * 2;
187: 
188:       val = getreg32(ICFGR(base, idx));
189:       val &= ~(GICD_ICFGR_MASK << shift);
190:       if (mode != IRQ_HIGH_LEVEL && mode != IRQ_LOW_LEVEL)
191:         {
192:           val |= (GICD_ICFGR_TYPE << shift);
193:         }
194: 
195:       putreg32(val, ICFGR(base, idx));
196:       return OK;
197:     }
198: 
199:   return -EINVAL;
200: }

283: void aarm64_gic_eoi_irq(unsigned int intid)
284: {
285:   /* Interrupt request deassertion from peripheral to GIC happens
286:    * by clearing interrupt condition by a write to the peripheral
287:    * register. It is desired that the write transfer is complete
288:    * before the core tries to change GIC state from 'AP/Active' to
289:    * a new state on seeing 'EOI write'.
290:    * Since ICC interface writes are not ordered against Device
291:    * memory writes, a barrier is required to ensure the ordering.
292:    * The dsb will also ensure *completion* of previous writes with
293:    * DEVICE nGnRnE attribute.
294:    */
295: 
296:   UP_DSB();
297: 
298:   /* (AP -> Pending) Or (Active -> Inactive) or (AP to AP) nested case */
299: 
300:   write_sysreg(intid, ICC_EOIR1_EL1);
301: 
302:   UP_ISB();
303: }
304: 
305: #ifdef CONFIG_ARM64_DECODEFIQ
306: void arm64_gic_eoi_fiq(unsigned int intid)
307: {
308:   /* Interrupt request deassertion from peripheral to GIC happens
309:    * by clearing interrupt condition by a write to the peripheral
310:    * register. It is desired that the write transfer is complete
311:    * before the core tries to change GIC state from 'AP/Active' to
312:    * a new state on seeing 'EOI write'.
313:    * Since ICC interface writes are not ordered against Device
314:    * memory writes, a barrier is required to ensure the ordering.
315:    * The dsb will also ensure *completion* of previous writes with
316:    * DEVICE nGnRnE attribute.
317:    */
318: 
319:   UP_DSB();
320: 
321:   /* (AP -> Pending) Or (Active -> Inactive) or (AP to AP) nested case */
322: 
323:   write_sysreg(intid, ICC_EOIR0_EL1);
324:   UP_ISB();
325: }
326: #endif

328: static int arm64_gic_send_sgi(unsigned int sgi_id, uint64_t target_aff,
329:                               uint16_t target_list)
330: {
331:   uint32_t aff3;
332:   uint32_t aff2;
333:   uint32_t aff1;
334:   uint64_t sgi_val;
335:   uint32_t regval;
336: 
337:   ASSERT(GIC_IS_SGI(sgi_id));
338: 
339:   /* Extract affinity fields from target */
340: 
341:   aff1 = MPIDR_AFFLVL(target_aff, 1);
342:   aff2 = MPIDR_AFFLVL(target_aff, 2);
343:   aff3 = MPIDR_AFFLVL(target_aff, 3);
344: 
345:   sgi_val = GICV3_SGIR_VALUE(aff3, aff2, aff1, sgi_id, SGIR_IRM_TO_AFF,
346:                              target_list);
347: 
348:   UP_DSB();
349: 
350:   /* Read the IGROUPR0 value we set in `gicv3_cpuif_init` */
351: 
352:   regval = IGROUPR_SGI_VAL;
353: 
354:   if (regval & BIT(sgi_id))
355:     {
356:       write_sysreg(sgi_val, ICC_SGI1R);     /* Group 1 */
357:     }
358:   else
359:     {
360:       write_sysreg(sgi_val, ICC_SGI0R_EL1); /* Group 0 */
361:     }
362: 
363:   UP_ISB();
364: 
365:   return 0;
366: }

368: void arm64_gic_raise_sgi(unsigned int sgi_id, uint16_t target_list)
369: {
370:   uint64_t pre_cluster_id = UINT64_MAX;
371:   uint64_t curr_cluster_id;
372:   uint64_t curr_mpidr;
373:   uint16_t tlist = 0;
374:   uint16_t cpu = 0;
375:   uint16_t i;
376: 
377:   while ((i = ffs(target_list)))
378:     {
379:       target_list >>= i;
380: 
381:       curr_mpidr = arm64_get_mpid(cpu + (i - 1));
382:       curr_cluster_id = MPID_TO_CLUSTER_ID(curr_mpidr);
383: 
384:       if (pre_cluster_id != UINT64_MAX &&
385:           pre_cluster_id != curr_cluster_id)
386:         {
387:           arm64_gic_send_sgi(sgi_id, pre_cluster_id, tlist);
388:         }
389: 
390:       tlist |= 1 << (curr_mpidr & MPIDR_AFFLVL_MASK);
391: 
392:       cpu += i;
393:       pre_cluster_id = curr_cluster_id;
394:     }
395: 
396:   arm64_gic_send_sgi(sgi_id, pre_cluster_id, tlist);
397: }

420: /* Initialize the cpu interface. This should be called by each core. */
421: 
422: static void gicv3_cpuif_init(void)
423: {
424:   uint32_t      icc_sre;
425:   uint32_t      intid;
426:   unsigned long base = gic_get_rdist() + GICR_SGI_BASE_OFF;
427: 
428:   /* Disable all sgi ppi */
429: 
430:   putreg32(INTBITS_ALL, ICENABLER(base, 0));
431: 
432:   /* Any sgi/ppi intid ie. 0-31 will select GICR_CTRL */
433: 
434:   gic_wait_rwp(0);
435: 
436:   /* Configure all SGIs/PPIs as G1S or G1NS depending on Zephyr
437:    * is run in EL1S or EL1NS respectively.
438:    * All interrupts will be delivered as irq
439:    */
440: 
441:   putreg32(IGROUPR_SGI_VAL, IGROUPR(base, 0));
442:   putreg32(INTBITS_ALL, IGROUPMODR(base, 0));
443: 
444:   /* Configure default priorities for SGI 0:15 and PPI 0:15. */
445: 
446:   for (intid = 0; intid < GIC_SPI_INT_BASE;
447:        intid += GIC_NUM_PRI_PER_REG)
448:     {
449:       putreg32(GIC_INT_DEF_PRI_X4, IPRIORITYR(base, intid));
450:     }
451: 
452:   /* Configure PPIs as level triggered */
453: 
454:   putreg32(0, ICFGR(base, 1));
455: 
456:   /* Check if system interface can be enabled.
457:    * 'icc_sre_el3' needs to be configured at 'EL3'
458:    * to allow access to 'icc_sre_el1' at 'EL1'
459:    * eg: z_arch_el3_plat_init can be used by platform.
460:    */
461: 
462:   icc_sre = read_sysreg(ICC_SRE_EL1);
463: 
464:   if (!(icc_sre & ICC_SRE_ELX_SRE_BIT))
465:     {
466:       icc_sre =
467:         (icc_sre | ICC_SRE_ELX_SRE_BIT | ICC_SRE_ELX_DIB_BIT |
468:          ICC_SRE_ELX_DFB_BIT);
469:       write_sysreg(icc_sre, ICC_SRE_EL1);
470: 
471:       UP_ISB();
472: 
473:       icc_sre = read_sysreg(ICC_SRE_EL1);
474: 
475:       ASSERT(icc_sre & ICC_SRE_ELX_SRE_BIT);
476:     }
477: 
478:   write_sysreg(GIC_IDLE_PRIO, ICC_PMR_EL1);
479: 
480:   /* Allow group1 interrupts */
481: 
482:   write_sysreg(1, ICC_IGRPEN1_EL1);
483: 
484: #ifdef CONFIG_ARM64_DECODEFIQ
485:   write_sysreg(1, ICC_IGRPEN0_EL1);
486: #endif
487: 
488:   UP_ISB();
489: }

491: static void gicv3_dist_init(void)
492: {
493:   unsigned int  num_ints;
494:   unsigned int  intid;
495:   unsigned int  idx;
496:   unsigned int  regval;
497:   unsigned long base = GIC_DIST_BASE;
498: 
499:   num_ints  = getreg32(GICD_TYPER);
500:   num_ints  &= GICD_TYPER_ITLINESNUM_MASK;
501:   num_ints  = (num_ints + 1) << 5;
502: 
503:   /* Disable the distributor */
504: 
505:   putreg32(0, GICD_CTLR);
506:   gic_wait_rwp(GIC_SPI_INT_BASE);
507: 
508:   /* Default configuration of all SPIs */
509: 
510:   for (intid = GIC_SPI_INT_BASE; intid < num_ints;
511:        intid += GIC_NUM_INTR_PER_REG)
512:     {
513:       idx = intid / GIC_NUM_INTR_PER_REG;
514: 
515:       /* Disable interrupt */
516: 
517:       putreg32(INTBITS_ALL, ICENABLER(base, idx));
518: 
519:       /* Clear pending */
520: 
521:       putreg32(INTBITS_ALL, ICPENDR(base, idx));
522:       putreg32(IGROUPR_VAL, IGROUPR(base, idx));
523:       putreg32(INTBITS_ALL, IGROUPMODR(base, idx));
524:     }
525: 
526:   /* wait for rwp on GICD */
527: 
528:   gic_wait_rwp(GIC_SPI_INT_BASE);
529: 
530:   /* Configure default priorities for all SPIs. */
531: 
532:   for (intid = GIC_SPI_INT_BASE; intid < num_ints;
533:        intid += GIC_NUM_PRI_PER_REG)
534:     {
535:       putreg32(GIC_INT_DEF_PRI_X4, IPRIORITYR(base, intid));
536:     }
537: 
538:   /* Configure all SPIs as active low, level triggered by default */
539: 
540:   for (intid = GIC_SPI_INT_BASE; intid < num_ints;
541:        intid += GIC_NUM_CFG_PER_REG)
542:     {
543:       idx = intid / GIC_NUM_CFG_PER_REG;
544: #ifdef CONFIG_ARM64_GICV3_SPI_EDGE
545:       /* Configure all SPIs as edge-triggered by default */
546: 
547:       putreg32(0xaaaaaaaa, ICFGR(base, idx));
548: #else
549:       /* Configure all SPIs as level-sensitive by default */
550: 
551:       putreg32(0, ICFGR(base, idx));
552: #endif
553:     }
554: 
555:   /* Configure SPI interrupt affinity routing to CPU0 */
556: 
557: #ifdef CONFIG_ARM64_GICV3_SPI_ROUTING_CPU0
558:   uint64_t mpid = arm64_get_mpid(0);
559: 
560:   for (intid = GIC_SPI_INT_BASE; intid < num_ints; intid++)
561:     {
562:       putreg64(mpid, IROUTER(base, intid));
563:     }
564: #endif
565: 
566:   /* TODO: Some arrch64 Cortex-A core maybe without security state
567:    * it has different GIC configure with standard arrch64 A or R core
568:    */
569: 
570: #ifdef CONFIG_ARCH_SINGLE_SECURITY_STATE
571:   /* For GIC single security state(ARMv8-R), the config means
572:    * the GIC is under single security state which has
573:    * only two groups:
574:    *  group 0 and group 1.
575:    * Then set GICD_CTLR_ARE and GICD_CTLR_ENABLE_G1 to enable Group 1
576:    * interrupt.
577:    * Since the GICD_CTLR_ARE and GICD_CTRL_ARE_S share BIT(4), and
578:    * similarly the GICD_CTLR_ENABLE_G1 and GICD_CTLR_ENABLE_G1NS share
579:    * BIT(1), we can reuse them.
580:    */
581: 
582:   regval = BIT(GICD_CTRL_ARE_S) | BIT(GICD_CTLR_ENABLE_G1NS);
583: 
584: #ifdef CONFIG_ARM64_DECODEFIQ
585:   regval |= BIT(GICD_CTLR_ENABLE_G0);
586: #endif
587: 
588:   putreg32(regval, GICD_CTLR);
589: 
590: #else
591:   /* Enable distributor with ARE */
592: 
593:   regval = BIT(GICD_CTRL_ARE_NS) | BIT(GICD_CTLR_ENABLE_G1NS);
594: 
595: #ifdef CONFIG_ARM64_DECODEFIQ
596:   regval |= BIT(GICD_CTLR_ENABLE_G0);
597: #endif
598: 
599:   putreg32(regval, GICD_CTLR);
600: #endif
601: 
602: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
603:   /* Attach SGI interrupt handlers. This attaches the handler to all CPUs. */
604: 
605:   DEBUGVERIFY(irq_attach(GIC_SMP_SCHED, arm64_smp_sched_handler, NULL));
606:   DEBUGVERIFY(irq_attach(GIC_SMP_CALL, nxsched_smp_call_handler, NULL));
607: #endif
608: }

660: int up_prioritize_irq(int irq, int priority)

665:               priority >= 0 && priority <= 255);

701: /***************************************************************************
702:  * Name: up_trigger_irq
703:  *
704:  * Description:
705:  *   Perform a Software Generated Interrupt (SGI).  If CONFIG_SMP is
706:  *   selected, then the SGI is sent to all CPUs specified in the CPU set.
707:  *   That set may include the current CPU.
708:  *
709:  *   If CONFIG_SMP is not selected, the cpuset is ignored and SGI is sent
710:  *   only to the current CPU.
711:  *
712:  * Input Parameters
713:  *   irq    - The SGI interrupt ID (0-15)
714:  *   cpuset - The set of CPUs to receive the SGI
715:  *
716:  ***************************************************************************/
717: 
718: void up_trigger_irq(int irq, cpu_set_t cpuset)
719: {
720:   uint32_t  mask  = BIT(irq & (GIC_NUM_INTR_PER_REG - 1));
721:   uint32_t  idx   = irq / GIC_NUM_INTR_PER_REG;
722: 
723:   if (GIC_IS_SGI(irq))
724:     {
725:       arm64_gic_raise_sgi(irq, cpuset);
726:     }
727:   else if (irq >= 0 && irq < NR_IRQS)
728:     {
729:       /* Write '1' to the corresponding bit in the distributor Interrupt
730:        * Set-Pending (ISPENDR)
731:        * GICD_ISPENDRn: Interrupt Set-Pending Registers
732:        */
733: 
734:       putreg32(mask, ISPENDR(GET_DIST_BASE(irq), idx));
735:     }
736: }

738: /***************************************************************************
739:  * Name: arm64_decodeirq
740:  *
741:  * Description:
742:  *   This function is called from the IRQ vector handler in arm64_vectors.S.
743:  *   At this point, the interrupt has been taken and the registers have
744:  *   been saved on the stack.  This function simply needs to determine the
745:  *   the irq number of the interrupt and then to call arm_doirq to dispatch
746:  *   the interrupt.
747:  *
748:  *  Input Parameters:
749:  *   regs - A pointer to the register save area on the stack.
750:  ***************************************************************************/
751: 
752: uint64_t * arm64_decodeirq(uint64_t * regs)
753: {
754:   int irq;
755: 
756:   /* Read the interrupt acknowledge register and get the interrupt ID */
757: 
758:   irq = arm64_gic_get_active_irq();
759: 
760:   /* Ignore spurions IRQs.  ICCIAR will report 1023 if there is no pending
761:    * interrupt.
762:    */
763: 
764:   DEBUGASSERT(irq < NR_IRQS || irq == SPURIOUS_INT);
765:   if (irq < NR_IRQS)
766:     {
767:       /* Dispatch the interrupt */
768: 
769:       regs = arm64_doirq(irq, regs);
770:     }
771: 
772:   /* Write to the end-of-interrupt register */
773: 
774:   aarm64_gic_eoi_irq(irq);
775: 
776:   return regs;
777: }

779: #ifdef CONFIG_ARM64_DECODEFIQ
780: uint64_t * arm64_decodefiq(uint64_t * regs)

396: /****************************************************************************

402:  * Input Parameters:

407: static inline void mmu_invalidate_tlb_by_vaddr(uintptr_t vaddr)
408: {
409:   __asm__ __volatile__
410:     (
411:       "dsb ishst\n"
412:       "tlbi vale1is, %0\n"
413:       "dsb ish\n"
414:       "isb"
415:       :

246:        */
247: 
248:       tcr |= TCR_EPD1_DISABLE;
249:     }
250:   else
251:     {
252:       tcr = (tcr_ps_bits << TCR_EL3_PS_SHIFT);
253:     }
254: 
255:   tcr |= TCR_T0SZ(va_bits);
256: 
257:   /* Translation table walk is cacheable, inner/outer WBWA and
258:    * inner shareable
259:    */
260: 
261:   tcr |= TCR_TG0_4K | TCR_SHARED_INNER | TCR_ORGN_WBWA |
262:          TCR_IRGN_WBWA | TCR_TBI_FLAGS;
263: 
264:   if (CONFIG_ARM64_PA_BITS == 52)
265:     {
266:       tcr |= TCR_DS;
267:     }
268: 
269:   return tcr;
270: }

272: static int pte_desc_type(uint64_t *pte)
273: {
274:   return *pte & PTE_DESC_TYPE_MASK;
275: }
276: 
277: static uint64_t *calculate_pte_index(uint64_t addr, int level)
278: {
279:   int base_level = XLAT_TABLE_BASE_LEVEL;
280:   uint64_t *pte;
281:   uint64_t idx;
282:   unsigned int i;
283: 
284:   /* Walk through all translation tables to find pte index */
285: 
286:   pte = (uint64_t *)base_xlat_table;
287:   for (i = base_level; i <= XLAT_TABLE_LEVEL_MAX; i++)
288:     {
289:       idx   = XLAT_TABLE_VA_IDX(addr, i);
290:       pte   += idx;
291: 
292:       /* Found pte index */
293: 
294:       if (i == level)
295:         {
296:           return pte;
297:         }
298: 
299:       /* if PTE is not table desc, can't traverse */
300: 
301:       if (pte_desc_type(pte) != PTE_TABLE_DESC)
302:         {
303:           return NULL;
304:         }
305: 
306:       /* Move to the next translation table level */
307: 
308:       pte = (uint64_t *)(*pte & 0x0000fffffffff000);
309:     }
310: 
311:   return NULL;
312: }
313: 
314: static void set_pte_table_desc(uint64_t *pte, uint64_t *table,
315:                                unsigned int level)
316: {
317: #ifdef CONFIG_ARM64_MMU_DEBUG
318:   sinfo("%s", XLAT_TABLE_LEVEL_SPACE(level));
319:   sinfo("%p: [Table] %p\n", pte, table);
320: #endif
321: 
322:   /* Point pte to new table */
323: 
324:   *pte = PTE_TABLE_DESC | (uint64_t)table;
325: }
326: 
327: static void set_pte_block_desc(uint64_t *pte, uint64_t addr_pa,
328:                                unsigned int attrs, unsigned int level)
329: {
330:   uint64_t desc = addr_pa;
331:   unsigned int mem_type;
332: 
333:   desc |= (level == 3) ? PTE_PAGE_DESC : PTE_BLOCK_DESC;
334: 
335:   /* NS bit for security memory access from secure state */
336: 
337:   desc |= (attrs & MT_NS) ? PTE_BLOCK_DESC_NS : 0;
338: 
339:   /* AP bits for Data access permission */
340: 
341:   desc |= (attrs & MT_RW) ? PTE_BLOCK_DESC_AP_RW : PTE_BLOCK_DESC_AP_RO;
342: 
343:   /* the access flag */
344: 
345:   desc |= PTE_BLOCK_DESC_AF;
346: 
347:   /* memory attribute index field */
348: 
349:   mem_type = MT_TYPE(attrs);
350:   desc |= PTE_BLOCK_DESC_MEMTYPE(mem_type);
351: 
352:   switch (mem_type)
353:     {
354:     case MT_DEVICE_NGNRNE:
355:     case MT_DEVICE_NGNRE:
356:     case MT_DEVICE_GRE:
357:       {
358:         /* Access to Device memory and non-cacheable memory are coherent
359:          * for all observers in the system and are treated as
360:          * Outer shareable, so, for these 2 types of memory,
361:          * it is not strictly needed to set shareability field
362:          */
363: 
364:         desc |= PTE_BLOCK_DESC_OUTER_SHARE;
365: 
366:         /* Map device memory as execute-never */
367: 
368:         desc |= PTE_BLOCK_DESC_PXN;
369:         desc |= PTE_BLOCK_DESC_UXN;
370:         break;
371:       }
372: 
373:     case MT_NORMAL_NC:
374:     case MT_NORMAL:
375:       {
376:         /* Make Normal RW memory as execute never */
377: 
378:         if (attrs & MT_EXECUTE_NEVER)
379:           {
380:             desc |= PTE_BLOCK_DESC_PXN;
381:           }
382: 
383:         if (mem_type == MT_NORMAL)
384:           {
385:             desc |= PTE_BLOCK_DESC_INNER_SHARE;
386:           }
387:         else
388:           {
389:             desc |= PTE_BLOCK_DESC_OUTER_SHARE;
390:           }
391:       }
392:     }
393: 
394: #if defined(CONFIG_ARM64_MMU_DEBUG) && defined(CONFIG_ARM64_MMU_DUMP_PTE)
395:   sinfo("%s ", XLAT_TABLE_LEVEL_SPACE(level));
396:   sinfo("%p: ", pte);
397:   sinfo("%s ",
398:         (mem_type ==
399:          MT_NORMAL) ? "MEM" :((mem_type == MT_NORMAL_NC) ? "NC" : "DEV"));
400:   sinfo("%s ", (attrs & MT_RW) ? "-RW" : "-RO");
401:   sinfo("%s ", (attrs & MT_NS) ? "-NS" : "-S");
402:   sinfo("%s ", (attrs & MT_EXECUTE_NEVER) ? "-XN" : "-EXEC");
403:   sinfo("\n");
404: #endif
405: 
406:   *pte = desc;
407: }

409: /* Returns a new reallocated table */
410: 
411: static uint64_t *new_prealloc_table(void)
412: {
413:   static unsigned int table_idx;
414: 
415:   __MMU_ASSERT(table_idx < CONFIG_ARM64_MAX_XLAT_TABLES,
416:                "Enough xlat tables not allocated");
417: 
418:   return (uint64_t *)(xlat_tables[table_idx++]);
419: }
